cards.name: Beyond the Gates of Sleep
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull] : -X. X is half the number of cards in your hand (rounded up).
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of revealed Enchanted Woods locations.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail and this is an attack or evasion attempt against a swarming enemy, add 1 swarm card to it.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X等於你手牌張數的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：-X。其中X為已揭示的魔幻森林地點數量。
[tablet]：-2。如果你失敗且本次檢定為對蜂擁敵人的攻擊或躲避嘗試，其增加1張蜂擁卡牌。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull] : -X. X is the number of cards in your hand.
[cultist]: -X. X is the number of revealed [[Woods]] locations.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack or evasion attempt against a swarming enemy, add 1 swarm card to it.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X等於你手牌張數。
[cultist]：-X。其中X為已揭示的[[樹林]]地點數量。
[tablet]：-2。如果本次檢定為對蜂擁敵人的攻擊或躲避嘗試，其增加1張蜂擁卡牌。

cards.name: Journey through the Gates
cards.text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda during the mythos phase, if any investigator is at a [[Steps]] location: Place 1 additional doom on this agenda.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 神話階段期間，在有毀滅標記放到本密謀上時，如果有調查員位於[[臺階]]地點：在本密謀上放置1個額外的毀滅標記。
cards.back_text:
If it is act 1, 2, or 3, read the following:
The steps begin to twist like a snake uncoiling from its sleep. You try to keep your balance, but there is nothing for you to cling to for safety as the stairs tilt and flip.
Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. Each of those investigators may test [willpower] (3) before being defeated to remember that this is all a dream. Each investigator who succeeds is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma, instead.
If it is act 4, read the following:
"Help! Please! Anyone!" The voice called out from the trees, far from the path. Normally, this sort of trick would not have fooled you, but the voice was too familiar to ignore. A loved one, perhaps, or someone you once failed in a time of need. It doesn't matter. It's too late now. You spin and look for the path, but it is nowhere to be found.
 Record in your Campaign Log the dreamers strayed from the path. Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果當前場景為場景1、場景2或場景3，閱讀以下文字：
臺階開始扭曲，像是一條從睡眠中甦醒的蛇。你想要保持平衡，但樓梯開始傾斜、翻轉，這兒沒有任何東西能讓你攀扶站穩。
倖存的每位調查員被擊敗，並受到1點肉體創傷。這些調查員在被擊敗之前，每人可以檢定[willpower](3)來記住這一切都是一場夢。檢定成功的調查員改為被擊敗並受到1點精神創傷。
如果當前場景為場景4，閱讀以下文字：
"救命！幫幫我！有人嗎！"遠離道路的樹林裡傳來一聲呼喊。正常來說，這種把戲騙不了你，但這道聲音實在太過耳熟，熟悉到你無法置若罔聞。也許是你愛的人，或者是曾在需要你的時候被你辜負的人。是誰都沒關係，現在已經晚了。你轉身尋找道路，但怎麼也找不到。
 在冒險日誌中記錄入夢者偏離了道路。倖存的所有調查員被擊敗，並每人受到1點精神創傷。

cards.name: Entering the Dreamlands
cards.text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If an investigator enters The Cavern of Flame, immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 神話階段期間，不要從遭遇牌堆抽取卡牌。 目標 - 如果有調查員進入火焰洞穴，立即推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Put the set-aside Nasht and Kaman-Thah enemies into play in The Cavern of Flame.
Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
cards.back_text_cn:
每位調查員失去自己的全部線索。
將放在一邊的納什特和卡曼塔敵人放置入場，放到火焰洞穴。
你越睡越沉。將1個[skull]標記加入混亂袋，持續到這個劇本結束。

cards.name: The Trial of Nasht and Kaman-Thah
cards.name_cn: 納什特和卡曼塔的考驗
cards.text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If neither Nasht nor Kaman-Thah are in play, immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 神話階段期間，不要從遭遇牌堆抽取卡牌。 目標 - 如果納什特和卡曼塔都不在場上，立即推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Put the set-aside Seven Hundred Steps, Base of the Steps, and The Enchanted Path locations into play.
Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign.
cards.back_text_cn:
每位調查員失去自己的全部線索。
將放在一邊的七百級臺階、樓梯底部和魔幻小路地點放置入場。
你越睡越沉。將1個[skull]標記加入混亂袋，持續到這個劇本結束。

cards.name: The Final Descent
cards.text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - If each investigator is at The Enchanted Path, immediately advance.
cards.text_cn: 神話階段期間，不要從遭遇牌堆抽取卡牌。 目標 - 如果所有調查員都位於魔幻小路，立即推進場景。
cards.back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. Your slumber grows deeper. Add 1 [skull] token to the chaos bag for the remainder of the campaign. Remove each [[Steps]] location from the game. Randomly choose 6 of the set-aside Enchanted Woods locations to put into play. Remove the other copy from the game. Shuffle all of the remaining set-aside scenario cards, except for Laboring Gug and Randolph Carter (Expert Dreamer), to form the encounter deck. (From now on, investigators draw cards from the encounter deck during each mythos phase, as normal.)
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員失去自己的全部線索。 你越睡越沉。將1個[skull]標記加入混亂袋，持續到這個劇本結束。 將所有[[臺階]]地點移出遊戲。 隨機從放在一邊的魔幻森林地點中選擇6張，放置入場。將未選擇的魔幻森林地點移出遊戲。 將剩餘的放在一邊的冒險卡混洗後形成遭遇牌堆，除了辛勞的古革巨人和倫道夫·卡特(夢境專家))。(從現在開始，調查員按照正常規則，在每個神話階段期間從遭遇牌堆抽取卡牌。)

cards.name: The Path
cards.text: Forced - After the first time any investigator enters an Enchanted Woods location: Record in your Campaign Log the dreamers strayed from the path. Objective - Only investigators at The Enchanted Path may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在任何調查員初次進入魔幻森林地點後：在冒險日誌中記錄入夢者偏離了道路。 目標 - 只有在魔幻小路的調查員能夠以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Step back and watch this surreal scene play out. (→R1) - Interrupt the scarred cat and handle this yourself. (→R2)
cards.back_text_cn: 調查員必須作出決定(選擇以下一項)： - 後退並觀察這離奇的一幕。(→結局1) - 打斷那隻貓的發言,自己來處理此事。(→結局2)

cards.name: Seventy Steps
cards.text: Forced - When you leave the Seventy Steps: Take 1 horror for each card in your hand in excess of 5. [fast]: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你離開七十級臺階時：:你手牌超出5張的部分，每有一張卡牌受到1點恐懼。 [free]：選擇並丟棄你1張手牌。

cards.name: The Cavern of Flame
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Each investigator in The Cavern of Flame takes 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當神話階段結束時：位於火焰洞穴的每位調查員受到1點傷害。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter The Cavern of Flame unless all of the clues on the Seventy Steps have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入火焰洞穴，除非七十級臺階的所有線索均已發現。

cards.name: Seven Hundred Steps
cards.text: Forced - When you leave the Seven Hundred Steps: Take 1 horror for each card in your hand in excess of 3. [fast]: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你離開七百級臺階時：你手牌超出3張的部分，每有一張卡牌，受到1點恐懼。 [free]：選擇並丟棄你1張手牌。

cards.name: Base of the Steps
cards.text: Forced - After you enter the Base of the Steps, if you have at least 1 card in your hand: Test [willpower] (X). X is the number of cards in your hand (after committing cards to this test). If you fail, for each card in your hand, you must either take 1 horror or discard that card.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入樓梯底部後，如果你有至少1張手牌：檢定[willpower](X)。X為你(投入卡牌到本次檢定後)的手牌張數。如果你檢定失敗，你手牌中每有1張卡牌，你必須受到1點恐懼，或者丟棄該卡牌。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter the Base of the Steps unless all of the clues on the Seven Hundred Steps have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入樓梯底部，除非七百級臺階的所有線索均已發現。

cards.name: The Enchanted Path
cards.text: The Enchanted Path is connected to each Enchanted Woods location. The Enchanted Path gets +1 shroud for each unrevealed Enchanted Woods location in play. [action] [action] [action]: You do as you were told... but you feel as though you are missing something. Place 1 clue on The Enchanted Path (from the token pool).
cards.text_cn: 魔幻小路與所有魔幻森林地點連接。 場上每有1個未揭示的魔幻森林地點，魔幻小路獲得+1隱藏值。 [action] action][action]：你遵照著之前所受的囑咐去做……但你總感覺自己遺漏了些什麼。將1個線索(從供應堆拿取)放到魔幻小路。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter The Enchanted Path unless all of the clues on the Base of the Steps have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入魔幻小路，除非樓梯底部的所有線索均已發現。

cards.name: Enchanted Woods
cards.text: As an additional cost for you to leave this location, you must choose and discard 1 card from your hand for each clue on this location.
cards.text_cn: 作為你離開本地點的額外費用，本地點每有1個線索，你必須選擇並丟棄你1張手牌。

cards.name: Enchanted Woods
cards.text: Forced - After a [[Zoog]] enemy with the swarming X keyword spawns at this location: Add 1 additional swarm card to it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在帶有蜂擁X關鍵詞的[[祖格鼠]]敵人生成在本地點後：添加1張額外的蜂擁卡牌到該敵人。

cards.name: Enchanted Woods
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Spawn the set-aside Laboring Gug at this location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點翻開之後：將放在一邊的"辛勞的古革巨人"生成在本地點。

cards.name: Enchanted Woods
cards.text: While you are investigating this location, it gets +1 shroud for each card in your hand.
cards.text_cn: 你調查本地點時，你每有1張手牌，其隱藏值+1。

cards.name: Enchanted Woods
cards.text: Forced - After you enter this location: You must either take 2 horror or lose all of your remaining actions.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入本地點後：你必須受到2點恐懼，或者失去你剩餘的全部行動。

cards.name: Enchanted Woods
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins, if you are at this location: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token, take 1 damage and lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你回合開始時，如果你位於本地點：從混亂袋隨機抽出1個標記。如果你抽出[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]標記，受到1點傷害並失去1個行動。

cards.name: Enchanted Woods
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal this location: If you do not leave this location before the end of the round, place 1 doom on the current agenda.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你翻開本地點後：如果你本輪結束前未離開本地點，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Kaman-Thah
cards.text: Aloof. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (2) to prove that you are worthy to enter the Dreamlands. This test gets +1 [per_investigator] difficulty. If you succeed, flip Kaman-Thah over and resolve the text on his other side. If you fail, Kaman-Thah attacks each investigator at his location. Forced - After you defeat Kaman-Thah: Flip him over and resolve the text on his other side.
cards.text_cn: 冷漠。反擊。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower]或[intellect](2)來證明你有資格進入幻夢境。本次檢定難度+1[per_investigator]。如果你檢定成功，將卡曼塔翻面並結算該面的文字。如果你檢定失敗，卡曼塔攻擊自己所在地點的每位調查員。 強制 - 在你擊敗卡曼塔之後：將其翻面並結算該面的文字。

cards.name: Nasht
cards.text: Aloof. Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [combat] or [agility] (2) to prove that you are worthy to enter the Dreamlands. This test gets +1 [per_investigator] difficulty. If you succeed, flip Nasht over and resolve the text on his other side. If you fail, Nasht attacks each investigator at his location. Forced - After you defeat Nasht: Flip him over and resolve the text on his other side.
cards.text_cn: 冷漠。反擊。 [action]：談判。 檢定[combat]或[agility](2)來證明你有資格進入幻夢境。本次檢定難度+1 [per_investigator]。如果你檢定成功，將納什特翻面並結算該面的文字。如果你檢定失敗，納什特攻擊自己所在地點的每位調查員。 強制 - 在你擊敗納什特之後：將其翻面並結算該面的文字。

cards.name: Randolph Carter
cards.text:
You get +1 [combat] and +1 [agility].
[reaction] After a [tablet] symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location, exhaust Randolph Carter: Draw 2 cards.
cards.text_cn:
你獲得+1[combat]和+1[agility]。
[reaction]你所在地點的技能檢定期間，在抽出[tablet]符號後，消耗倫道夫·卡特：抽取2張卡牌。

cards.name: Laboring Gug
cards.text:
Hunter.
Laboring Gug cannot enter The Enchanted Path.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
辛勞的古革巨人不能進入魔幻小路。

cards.name: Ancient Zoog
cards.text: Spawn - Any Enchanted Woods location (unrevealed, if able). Aloof. Forced - At the start of the enemy phase, if Ancient Zoog is ready: Add 1 swarm card to each swarming [[Zoog]] enemy in play.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個魔幻森林地點(如果可能，生成在未揭示的魔幻森林地點)。 冷漠。 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時，如果遠古祖格鼠已準備：增加1張蜂擁卡牌到場上的每個帶有蜂擁關鍵詞的[[祖格鼠]]敵人。

cards.name: Lost in the Woods
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - Each investigator at an Enchanted Woods location tests [willpower] (3). Each investigator who fails loses 1 action and takes 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 - 位於魔幻森林地點的每位調查員檢定[willpower](3)。檢定失敗的每位調查員失去1個行動並受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Waking Nightmare
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are engaged with a [[Staff]] enemy).
[cultist]: Reveal another chaos token. If you fail and it is agenda 2 or 3, make an infestation test.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the number of infested locations.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你與[[職工]]敵人交戰，改為-3)。
[cultist]：再抽一個混亂標記。如果你檢定失敗且當前密謀為密謀2或密謀3，進行一次蛛群滋生檢定。
[elder_thing]：-X。其中X為蛛巢地點數量。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are engaged with a [[Staff]] enemy).
[cultist]: Reveal another chaos token. If it is agenda 2 or 3, make an infestation test.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is 1 higher than the number of infested locations.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2(如果你與[[職工]]敵人交戰，改為-4)。
[cultist]：再抽一個混亂標記。如果當前密謀為密謀2或密謀3，進行一次蛛群滋生檢定。
[elder_thing]：-X。其中X為蛛巢地點數量+1。

cards.name: Halls of St. Mary's
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Spiders encounter set and each set-aside copy of Outbreak into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Draw the set-aside The Infestation Begins story card and resolve its text.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的每張爆發和蜘蛛遭遇組和遭遇棄牌堆一同洗入遭遇牌堆。 抽取放在一邊的蛛群入侵劇情卡牌並結算其文字。

cards.name: The Infestation Spreads
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當神話階段結束時：進行一次蛛群滋生檢定。
cards.back_text: Find each Suspicious Orderly enemy in play and replace it with a set-aside Corrupted Orderly enemy (it keeps its game state, all tokens, and all attachments). Search the encounter deck and discard pile for each copy of Suspicious Orderly and remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Agents of Atlach-Nacha encounter set, each remaining set-aside Corrupted Orderly enemy, and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Add 1 [skull] token and 1 [cultist] token to the infestation bag.
cards.back_text_cn: 找出場上每張可疑的護工敵人，將其分別替換為1張放在一邊的墮落的護工敵人(其遊戲狀態、所有標記和疊加卡牌保持不變)。 查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出所有可疑的護工，將其移出遊戲。 將遭遇棄牌堆、放在一邊的阿特拉克·納克亞的使徒遭遇組和剩餘的墮落的護工敵人一同洗入遭遇牌堆。 將1個[skull]標記和1個[cultist]標記加入到蛛群滋生袋。

cards.name: Hospital of Horrors
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Make an infestation test. Each [[Spider]] enemy at an infested location gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 當神話階段結束時：進行一次蛛群滋生檢定。 位於蛛巢地點的每個[[蜘蛛]]敵人+1攻擊，+1躲避。
cards.back_text: In your Campaign Log, record 8 tally marks next to "Steps of the Bridge." (→R4)
cards.back_text_cn: 在冒險日誌"橋樑進度"旁邊作8次記錄。 (→結局4)

cards.name: Looking for Answers
cards.back_text:
Put the set-aside Stairwell and Basement Door locations into play.
Check the current agenda.
- If it is agenda 2 or 3, make an infestation test.
- If it is agenda 1, immediately advance to agenda 2.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的梯井和地下室的門地點放置入場。
檢查當前密謀。
- 如果當前密謀為密謀2或密謀3，進行一次蛛群滋生檢定。
- 如果當前密謀為密謀1，立即推進至密謀2。

cards.name: Search for the Patient
cards.text: Objective - If an investigator controls Randolph Carter, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 如果有調查員控制倫道夫·卡特，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Containing the Outbreak
cards.text: Each infested location gains: "[action]: Test [willpower] (X) to attempt to seal the rift. X is this location's shroud. Investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to automatically succeed. If you succeed, replace the damage token on this location with a horror token. For the remainder of the game, this location cannot become infested." Objective - If there are no infested locations in play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個蛛巢地點獲得："[action]：檢定[willpower](X)來嘗試彌合裂痕，其中X等於本地點的隱藏值。本地點的調查員可以以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索，以使本次檢定自動成功。如果你檢定成功，將本地點上的傷害標記替換為恐懼標記。本場遊戲結束前，本地點不能變成蛛巢。" 目標 - 如果場上沒有蛛巢地點，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If Dr. Maheswaran joined the investigation and she was in play when the scenario ended, (→R1). - If Dr. Maheswaran joined the investigation and she was not in play when the scenario ended, (→R2). - If Dr. Maheswaran stayed with her patients , (→R3).
cards.back_text_cn: 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果馬斯沃倫醫生與你一同調查，並且本場冒險結束時她仍在場上(→結局1)。 - 如果馬斯沃倫醫生與你一同調查，並且本場冒險結束時她不在場上(→結局2)。 - 如果馬斯沃倫醫生留在病人身邊(→結局3)。

cards.name: Waiting Room
cards.text: While Waiting Room is not infested, it gains: "[action]: Resign. You flee the hospital, leaving your companions behind."
cards.text_cn: 候診室沒有變成蛛巢時，其獲得："[action]：撤退。你逃出了這所醫院，把同伴留在裡面。"

cards.name: Emergency Room
cards.text: While you are in the Emergency Room, each of your skill tests gets +1 difficulty for each card committed to it.
cards.text_cn: 你位於急救病房時，每有1張卡牌投入到你進行的技能檢定，檢定難度+1。

cards.name: Experimental Therapies Ward
cards.text: [reaction] When you investigate Experimental Therapies Ward, take 1 horror: Experimental Therapies Ward gets -2 shroud for this investigation.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你調查實驗療法病房時，受到1點恐懼：本次調查期間，實驗療法病房隱藏值-2。

cards.name: Records Office
cards.text: [action] [action] [action] If you are not engaged with any enemies: One at a time, take 4 basic investigate actions.
cards.text_cn: [action][action][action]如果你未與任何敵人交戰：逐次進行4個基礎調查行動。

cards.name: Stairwell
cards.text: [reaction] After you enter Stairwell from a non-[[Basement]] location: Move to a [[Basement]] location. Then, test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 2 damage. Forced - After Stairwell becomes infested: Make an infestation test.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你從非[[地下室]]地點進入梯井之後：移動到1個[[地下室]]地點。然後，檢定[agility](4)。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點傷害。 強制 - 在梯井變成蛛巢之後：進行一次蛛群滋生檢定。

cards.name: Morgue
cards.text: [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discover 1 clue at this location. If you fail, take 1 horror. Forced - After the last remaining clue is discovered from Morgue: Make an infestation test.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，發現本地點的1個線索。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點恐懼。 強制 - 從太平間發現最後一個線索後：進行一次蛛群滋生檢定。

cards.name: Operating Room
cards.text: [action] [action]: Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, heal 3 damage from that investigator. If you fail, deal 1 damage to that investigator.
cards.text_cn: [action][action]：選擇你所在地點的1位調查員，你檢定[intellect](4)。如果你檢定成功，治癒該調查員的3點傷害。如果你檢定失敗，對該調查員造成1點傷害。

cards.name: Private Room
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues as a group to give control of the set-aside Randolph Carter asset to an investigator at this location.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。 檢定[willpower](2)。如果你檢定成功，檢定[intellect](2)。如果你檢定成功，位於本地點的調查員可以以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來將放在一邊的倫道夫·卡特支援置於本地點的一位調查員控制之下。

cards.name: The Infestation Begins...
cards.text:
Place 1 damage token on the location with the most clues (the 2 locations with the most clues if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). For the remainder of the scenario, damage tokens on locations represent the spreading infestation. Each location with a damage token on it is an "infested" location.
Create a separate bag consisting of the following tokens: [skull], [tablet], [tablet], [tablet], [tablet], [cultist], [cultist]. (If you do not have a second bag, use a cup, bowl, or other opaque container.) This is the infestation bag, and these are infestation tokens. They are not chaos tokens.
Some abilities will instruct the players to make an infestation test. An infestation test may cause the infestation to spread to other locations or endanger investigators at infested locations. To resolve an infestation test, an investigator must reveal a random infestation token from the infestation bag, and resolve the effects for that token as indicated on the other side of this card.
Flip this card over and place it next to the scenario reference card.
cards.text_cn:
在線索最多的地點上放置1個傷害標記(如果本場遊戲中有3到4位調查員，改為在線索最多的2個地點上放置)。在本場冒險接下來的時間裡，地點上的傷害標記表示蛛群的蔓延路線。帶有傷害標記的每個地點視為"蛛巢"地點。
使用以下標記單獨創建一個標記抽取袋：[skull], [tablet], [tablet], [tablet], [tablet], [cultist], [cultist]。(如果你沒有其他袋子，可以使用杯子、碗，或者其他不透明容器。)這就是蛛群滋生袋，而袋中的標記則是蛛群滋生標記。這些標記不是混亂標記。
有的能力會指示玩家進行蛛群滋生檢定。蛛群滋生檢定可能導致蛛群蔓延到其他地點，或者使位於蛛巢地點的調查員陷入危險。要想結算蛛群滋生檢定，調查員必須從蛛群滋生袋中隨機抽出1個蛛群滋生標記，根據本卡牌背面所示，結算該標記的效果。
將本卡牌翻面並放到冒險輔助卡旁。
cards.back_text: Use these results only when revealing infestation tokens from the infestation bag. [skull]: Set this token aside. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Spider]] enemy and spawn it at the infested location nearest to any investigator. [tablet]: Set this token aside. [cultist]: Set this token aside. Choose a location connected to an infested location. That location becomes infested (place a damage token on it to mark this.). Then, if there are 2 or more [cultist] tokens set aside, return all set-aside infestation tokens to the infestation bag.
cards.back_text_cn: 從蛛群滋生袋中抽出蛛群滋生標記時才能結算以下文字。 [skull]：將本標記放在一邊。查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出1張[[蜘蛛]]敵人，將其生成在距離任意一位調查員最近的蛛巢地點。 [tablet]：將本標記放在一邊。 [cultist]：將本標記放在一邊。選擇與蛛巢地點連接的1個地點。該地點變成蛛巢(在該地點上放置1個傷害標記作為表示)。然後，如果有至少2個[cultist]標記被放在一邊，將所有放在一邊的蛛群滋生標記放回蛛群滋生袋。

cards.name: Randolph Carter
cards.text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After an [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a skill test at your location, exhaust Randolph Carter: Draw 2 cards.
cards.text_cn:
你獲得+1[willpower]和+1[intellect]。
[reaction]你所在地點結算的技能檢定期間，在抽出[elder_thing]符號後，消耗倫道夫·卡特：抽取2張卡牌。

cards.name: Dr. Shivani Maheswaran
cards.text:
[fast] Exhaust Dr. Shivani Maheswaran: Automatically evade an engaged Suspicious Orderly.
[reaction] When an investigator reveals a [skull] or [cultist] symbol on an infestation token, remove Dr. Shivani Maheswaran from the game: Cancel that token and return it to the infestation bag.
cards.text_cn:
[free]消耗席瓦妮·馬斯沃倫醫生：自動躲避交戰的可疑的護工。
[reaction]在有調查員抽出1個[skull]或[cultist]符號作為蛛群滋生標記時，將席瓦妮·馬斯沃倫醫生移出遊戲：取消該標記並將其放回蛛群滋生袋。

cards.name: Suspicious Orderly
cards.text:
Hunter.
Suspicious Orderly cannot attack, be attacked, or be dealt damage.
While Suspicious Orderly is engaged with you, you cannot investigate.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
可疑的護工不能攻擊，不能受到攻擊，也不能受到傷害。
可疑的護工與你交戰時，你不能調查。

cards.name: Corrupted Orderly
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - When Corrupted Orderly is dealt 1 or more damage while at an infested location: Cancel 1 of that damage.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 在位於蛛巢地點的墮落的護工受到至少1點傷害時：取消該傷害中的1點。

cards.name: Outbreak
cards.text: Revelation - Perform an infestation test. If you are at an infested location, treat each [tablet] token you reveal as a [skull] token instead.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 執行一次蛛群滋生檢定。如果你位於蛛巢地點，你抽出的每個[tablet]標記改為視作[skull]標記。

cards.name: Grey Weaver
cards.text: Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter. While Grey Weaver is ready, each investigator at its location cannot take move actions.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - [agility]最低的目標。 獵手。 只要灰織蛛準備，位於其地點的每位調查員不能進行移動行動。

cards.name: Will of the Spider-Mother
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If there is a [[Spider]] enemy at your location, you cannot commit cards to this skill test. If you fail, you cannot attack or investigate until the end of the round.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你所在地點有[[蜘蛛]]敵人，你不能在本次檢定投入卡牌。如果你檢定失敗，你不能攻擊也不能調查，直到本輪結束。

cards.name: The Crawling Mist
cards.text: Prey - Most cards in hand. Hunter. Massive. Increase the difficulty for you to attack or attempt to evade The Crawling Mist by 1 for each card in your hand with an encounter card back.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 手牌最多的目標。 獵手。龐大。 你手牌中每有一張卡牌牌背為遭遇卡，你攻擊或嘗試躲避蠕行之霧的難度提高1點。

cards.name: Law of 'Ygiroth
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. You cannot play cards or trigger abilities on player cards with an odd printed resource cost. [action] Discard a player card with an even printed resource cost from your hand: Discard this card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 秘密地將本卡牌加入你的手牌。 你不能打出印刷資源費用為奇數的卡牌，也不能觸發印刷資源費用為奇數的玩家卡上的能力。 [action]從你手牌中丟棄一張印刷資源費用為偶數的玩家卡：從你手牌中棄掉本卡牌。

cards.name: Law of 'Ygiroth
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. You cannot commit cards to skill tests with an odd number of total skill icons on them. [action] Discard a player card with an even number of total skill icons from your hand: Discard this card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 秘密地將本卡牌加入你的手牌。 你不能對技能檢定投入技能圖標總數為奇數的卡牌。 [action]從你手牌中丟棄一張技能圖標總數為偶數的玩家卡：從你手牌中棄掉本卡牌。

cards.name: Law of 'Ygiroth
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. You cannot play cards or commit cards to skill tests with an odd number of words in their title. (A word is any text separated by spaces.) [action] Discard a player card with an even number of words in its title from your hand: Discard this card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 秘密地將本卡牌加入你的手牌。 你不能打出右下角編號為奇數的卡牌，也不能將右下角編號為奇數的卡牌投入技能檢定。 [action]從你手牌中丟棄一張右下角編號為偶數的玩家卡：從你手牌中棄掉本卡牌。

cards.name: Whispers of Hypnos
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - Choose a skill ([willpower], [intellect], [combat], or [agility]). For the remainder of the round, each investigator gets -2 to the chosen skill. You cannot choose a skill that has already been chosen by a copy of this effect this round.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 選擇一項技能([willpower]、[intellect]、[combat]或[agility])。在本輪接下來的時間裡，每位調查員所選技能-2。不能選擇本輪已被相同卡牌效果選擇的技能。

cards.name: Hunting Ghast
cards.text: Hunter. Prey - Most damage. Forced - After Hunting Ghast enters a location with a [[Gug]] enemy: Ready each [[Gug]] enemy at its location and deal 1 damage to Hunting Ghast.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 獵物 - 受到最多傷害的目標。 強制 - 在追獵噩妖進入[[古革巨人]]敵人所在地點後：準備該地點的每個[[古革巨人]]敵人，並對追獵噩妖造成1點傷害。

cards.name: Lumbering Gug
cards.text: Forced - After Lumbering Gug exhausts: It does not ready during the next upkeep phase.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在笨拙的古革巨人消耗後：在下一個補給階段期間，本卡牌不準備。

cards.name: Dreamer's Curse
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, take 1 damage, to a maximum of 3 damage. For the purposes of counting icons committed to this skill test, [intellect], [combat], and [agility] icons count as matching icons, and [willpower] and [wild] icons count as 2 matching icons.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](5)。你每低於難度1點，受到1點傷害，最多受到3點傷害。統計投入本技能檢定的圖標時，[intellect]、[combat]和[agility]圖標計為1個匹配圖標，[willpower]和[wild]圖標計為2個匹配圖標。

cards.name: Somniphobia
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (5). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror, to a maximum of 3 horror. For the purposes of counting icons committed to this skill test, [intellect], [combat], and [agility] icons count as matching icons, and [willpower] and [wild] icons count as 2 matching icons.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](5)。你每低於難度1點，受到1點恐懼，最多受到3點恐懼。統計投入本技能檢定的圖標時，[intellect]、[combat]和[agility]圖標計為1個匹配圖標，[willpower]和[wild]圖標計為2個匹配圖標。

cards.name: Deeper Slumber
cards.text: Revelation - Put Deeper Slumber into play in your threat area. Your maximum hand size is reduced by 3 and is checked after each time you draw 1 or more cards. [action] [action]: Discard Deeper Slumber.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將沉眠放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 你的手牌上限減少3張，並且在你每次抽取(1張或多張)卡牌後檢查上限。 [action][action]：丟棄沉眠。

cards.name: Dreamlands Eclipse
cards.text: Revelation - Put Dreamlands Eclipse into play next to the agenda deck. Forced - When you initiate an investigation: You must either take 1 horror, or your location gets +2 shroud for this investigation. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Dreamlands Eclipse.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將幻夢境月食放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁邊。 強制 - 在你發動一次調查時：你必須受到1點恐懼，或你所在地點本次調查期間隱藏值+2。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：丟棄幻夢境月食。

cards.name: Prismatic Phenomenon
cards.text: Revelation - Put Prismatic Phenomenon into play in your threat area. The first time you perform one of the following actions (draw, resource, or play) each round, it costs 1 additional action. Forced - After you successfully investigate a location: Instead of discovering clues, discard Prismatic Phenomenon.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將棱鏡光華放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 每輪你第一次執行以下任何行動(抽牌、資源或打出)時，花費額外1個行動。 強制 - 在你成功調查一個地點後：不發現線索，改為丟棄棱鏡光華。

cards.name: Night Terrors
cards.text: Revelation - Put Night Terrors into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness revealed this way and remove the other cards from the game. [action] If Night Terrors is in your threat area: Test [willpower] (4). After this test ends, discard Night Terrors (even if you fail).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將黑夜恐怖放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 在你技能檢定失敗後：揭示你牌堆頂的3張卡牌。抽取以此方式揭示的所有弱點卡，然後將其他卡片移出遊戲。 [action]如果黑夜恐怖在你的威脅區域：檢定[willpower](4)。本次檢定結束後，丟棄黑夜恐怖(即便你檢定失敗)。

cards.name: Glimpse of the Underworld
cards.text: Revelation - Put Glimpse of the Underworld into play in your threat area. Forced - When you would take damage and/or horror: Take 1 additional damage or horror. [fast]: Discard Glimpse of the Underworld. Then, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將窺看地下世界放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 在你將要受到傷害和/或恐懼時：受到額外1點傷害或恐懼。 [free]：丟棄窺看地下世界。然後，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。

cards.name: Threads of Reality
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the non-permanent, non-weakness asset you control with the highest printed cost. Otherwise, Threads of Reality gains surge. Treat attached asset as if its printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]] and forced abilities). [action] Discard an asset you control: Discard Threads of Reality.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你控制的印刷費用最高的非永久且非弱點的支援卡。否則，現實之線獲得湧動。 將被疊加的支援卡的印刷文本框視為空白([[屬性]]和強制能力除外)。 [action]丟棄你控制的1張支援卡：丟棄現實之線。

cards.name: Spider of Leng
cards.text: Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Add 1 swarm card to each Swarm of Spiders enemy in play. If there are no Swarm of Spiders enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Swarm of Spiders enemy and spawn it at Spider of Leng's location with no swarm cards.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在敵軍階段結束時：增加1張蜂擁卡牌到場上的每張蛛群敵人上。如果場上沒有蛛群敵人，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張蛛群，將其生成(不帶蜂擁卡牌)在冷原蜘蛛所在地點。

cards.name: Swarm of Spiders
cards.text: Swarming 2. X equals the number of Swarm of Spiders enemies at this location (including swarm cards).
cards.text_cn: 蜂擁2。 X為本地點的蛛群敵人數量(包括蜂擁卡牌)。

cards.name: Sickening Webs
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Each [[Spider]] enemy at attached location gains retaliate and alert. Investigators cannot move out of attached location. [action]: Test [combat] (3) or [agility] (3). If you succeed, discard Sickening Webs.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點。 疊加地點上的每個[[蜘蛛]]敵人獲得反擊和警戒。調查員不能移動離開疊加地點。 [action]：檢定[combat](3)或[agility](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄噁心蛛網。

cards.name: Hunted by Corsairs
cards.text: Revelation - Attach Hunted by Corsairs to the current act. Forced - When the act advances: Each investigator takes 2 damage. Attached act gains: "[action]: Test [intellect] (4) to outwit the Corsairs or [agility] (4) to sneak past them. If you succeed, discard Hunted by Corsairs."
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將海盜追獵疊加到當前場景。 強制 - 在場景推進時：每位調查員受到2點傷害。 疊加的場景獲得："[action]：檢定[intellect](4)智勝海盜，或檢定[agility](4)偷偷溜走。如果你檢定成功，丟棄海盜追獵。"

cards.name: Corsair of Leng
cards.text: Spawn - Nearest [[City]] or [[Surface]] location. Alert. Forced - After Corsair of Leng attacks via its alert keyword: It gets -3 evade for the remainder of the phase.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 最近的[[城市]]或[[月面]]地點。 警戒。 強制 - 在冷原海盜通過其警戒關鍵詞進行攻擊後：直到本階段結束，其躲避值-3。

cards.name: Furtive Zoog
cards.text: Spawn - Engaged with the investigator at your location with the lowest [combat]. Prey - Lowest [combat]. Retaliate. Swarming 1.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 與你所在地點[combat]最低的調查員交戰。 獵物 - [combat]最低的目標。 反擊。蜂擁1。

cards.name: Stealthy Zoog
cards.text: Spawn - Engaged with the investigator at your location with the lowest [agility]. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Alert. Swarming 1.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 與你所在地點[agility]最低的調查員交戰。。 獵物 - [agility]最低的目標。 警戒。蜂擁1。

cards.name: Inconspicuous Zoog
cards.text: Spawn - Any connecting location. Hunter. Swarming 2. Forced - When Inconspicuous Zoog is defeated: Cancel all excess damage and move any of its remaining swarm/host cards to a connecting location, exhausted.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個連接地點。 獵手。蜂擁2。 強制 - 在隱蔽的祖格鼠被擊敗時：取消所有過量傷害，並將其剩餘的蜂擁/頭領卡牌移動到一個連接地點，呈消耗狀態。

cards.name: Zoog Burrow
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, add 1 swarm card to the nearest swarming [[Zoog]] enemy. If you fail and there are no such enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Zoog]] enemy, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](3)。你每低於難度1點，增加1張蜂擁卡牌到最近的帶有蜂擁關鍵詞的[[祖格鼠]]敵人。如果你檢定失敗且場上沒有這類敵人，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一張[[祖格鼠]]敵人，混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Search for Kadath
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of Signs of the Gods the investigators have uncovered.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If this token is revealed during an investigation and this skill test fails, increase that location's shroud by 1 for the remainder of the round.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or place 1 doom on the current agenda.
[elder_thing]: +2. The black cat points you in the right direction. If this token is revealed during an investigation and you succeed, discover 1 additional clue.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X等於調查員發現的神跡數量。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果本標記是在調查期間抽出的，並且該次技能檢定失敗，則該地點的隱藏值+1，直到本輪結束。
[tablet]：-2。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼，或在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
[elder_thing]：+2。黑貓指引你正確的方向。如果本標記是在調查期間抽出的，並且你檢定成功，則發現額外1個線索。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of Signs of the Gods the investigators have uncovered.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If this token is revealed during an investigation and this skill test fails, increase that location's shroud by 2 for the remainder of the round.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or place 1 doom on the current agenda.
[elder_thing]: +1. The black cat points you in the right direction. If this token is revealed during an investigation and you succeed, discover 1 additional clue.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X等於調查員發現的神跡數量+1。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果本標記是在調查期間抽出的，並且該次技能檢定失敗，則該地點的隱藏值+2，直到本輪結束。
[tablet]：-3。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼，或在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
[elder_thing]：+1。黑貓指引你正確的方向。如果本標記是在調查期間抽出的，並且你檢定成功，則發現額外1個線索。

cards.text: [action] If you are at a [[Port]] location: Resign. Venturing into the unknown has become too dangerous, so you return to safety with the information you've gathered.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你位於[[港口]]地點：撤退。進入未知領域冒險一事變得過於危險，所以你帶著目前蒐集到的一切返回安全的地方。

cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的2張"冷原海盜"敵人和遭遇棄牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Kingdom of the Skai
cards.text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at a [[Port]] location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 當一輪結束時，位於[[港口]]地點的調查員可以以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and all play areas for Cats of Ulthar, each Pack of Vooniths, and each card from the Zoogs encounter set, and remove them from the game. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Priest of a Thousand Masks into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. The investigators must decide (choose one): - Visit the isle of Oriab to the south. Resolve Oriab Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the ancient land of Mnar to the west. Resolve Mnar Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the Forbidden Lands to the north. Resolve Forbidden Lands Setup in the Campaign Guide. - Visit the kingdom of the Timeless Realm to the east. Resolve Timeless Realm Setup in the Campaign Guide.

cards.text: Veiled.
cards.text_cn: 掩藏。

cards.name: Skai River
cards.text: Forced - When you attempt to leave Skai River, if it has not yet been flipped over: Test [willpower] (2) or [agility] (2). If you fail, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你試圖離開斯凱河時，如果該地點未被翻面過：檢定[willpower](2)或[agility](2)。如果你檢定失敗，將本卡牌翻至另一面並且結算該面的文字。

cards.name: Dylath-Leen
cards.text:
Veiled.
[action] Spend 1 resource: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an [[Item]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
[action]花費1資源：查找你牌堆頂上的6張卡牌，找出一張[[道具]]支援卡並抽取該卡。混洗你的牌堆。

cards.name: Kadatheron
cards.text:
Veiled.
[action] [action] [action]: Draw 5 cards.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
[action][action][action]：抽取5張卡牌。

cards.name: Sarnath
cards.text: Veiled. Sarnath cannot be flipped over unless the investigators "know what happened to Ib." Forced - After you successfully investigate Sarnath by 1 or less: Take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 掩藏。不能將薩爾納斯翻面，除非調查員"知道伊伯發生的事情"。 強制 - 在你成功調查薩爾納斯，且結果等於難度或超過難度1點後：受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Ruins of Ib
cards.text: Veiled. Forced - After you reveal a [skull] or [cultist] token while investigating Ruins of Ib: Discard an asset you control.
cards.text_cn: Veiled. Forced - After you reveal a [skull] or [cultist] token while investigating Ruins of Ib: Discard an asset you control.
cards.back_text_cn: 掩藏。 強制 - 在你調查伊伯遺跡時抽出了[skull]或[cultist]標記後：棄掉你控制的1張支援卡。

cards.name: Ilek-Vad
cards.text:
Veiled.
While you are at Ilek-Vad, reduce the cost of the first [[Spell]], [[Ritual]], or [[Relic]] card you play each round by 1.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
你位於伊萊克-瓦達時，你每輪打出的第一張[[法術]]、[[儀式]]或[[遺物]]卡牌費用減少1點。

cards.name: Forbidden Lands
cards.text: [action]: Test [combat] (1). If you succeed, test [agility] (2). If you succeed, test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, flip this card over. If you fail any of these tests, take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[combat](1)。如果你檢定成功，檢定[agility](2)。如果你檢定成功，檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，將本卡牌翻面。如果你在上述任何檢定中檢定失敗，受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Zulan-Thek
cards.text: Veiled. Forced - At the end of the round: Add 1 swarm card to Horde of Night for each investigator in Zulan-Thek.
cards.text_cn: 掩藏。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：每有1位調查員位於祖蘭-提克，增加1張蜂擁卡牌到夜色怪群上。

cards.name: Baharna
cards.text: Veiled.
cards.text_cn: 掩藏。

cards.name: Mt. Ngranek

cards.text_cn: 掩藏。 強制 - 在你進入恩格拉尼克山脈，或發現恩格拉尼克山脈的線索後，如果調查員未"在巴哈那港口獲取補給": 檢定[combat](3)或[agility](3)。如果你檢定失敗，失去你所有剩餘的行動，立即結束你的回合。

cards.name: Nameless Ruins
cards.text: Veiled. Forced - After you end your turn at Nameless Ruins: Deal 1 direct damage to an [[Ally]] asset you control.
cards.text_cn: 掩藏。 強制 - 在你在無名遺跡結束自己的回合後：對你控制的一張[[盟友]]支援卡造成1點直接傷害。

cards.name: Celephaïs
cards.text: Veiled.
cards.text_cn: 掩藏。

Veiled.

作為你進入或離開本地點的額外費用，你必須選擇並棄掉你1張手牌。

進入神廟的道路已被堵住。你不能進入無以達願之廟 ，除非調查員"向王祈求幫助"了。

cards.name: Virgil Gray

cards.text_cn: [reaction]在發現至少1個神跡後：抽取1張卡牌、獲得1個資源或治癒維吉爾·格雷的1點恐懼。如果有超過1位調查員進行本場遊戲，將維吉爾·格雷的控制權交給另一位調查員。 強制 - 如果維吉爾·格雷離場：將其移出遊戲。(FAQ, v2.0)

cards.name: Cats of Ulthar
cards.text: Swarming 2. When you reveal chaos tokens while attempting to evade this enemy, reveal an additional token. (Limit once per test.) Forced - The first time an investigator defeats Cats of Ulthar (or one of its swarm cards): Add 3 swarm cards to the host and record in your Campaign Log (your investigator name) has broken the law of Ulthar.
cards.text_cn: 蜂擁2。 嘗試躲避本敵人時，在你抽出混亂標記時，額外抽出1個標記。(每次檢定限制一次。) 強制 - 調查員第一次擊敗烏撒之貓(或者擊敗其1張蜂擁卡牌)：添加3張蜂擁卡牌到其頭領卡牌上，並在冒險日誌中記錄(你的調查員姓名)已打破烏撒的法則。

cards.name: Stalking Manticore
cards.text: Forced - If you successfully evade Stalking Manticore: Disengage from it, but do not exhaust it. Until the end of the phase, it cannot engage you.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 如果你成功躲避跟蹤的蠍獅：解除與其的交戰，但不將其消耗。其不能與你交戰，直到本階段結束。

cards.name: Horde of Night
cards.text:
Massive. Swarming 1 [per_investigator].
Horde of Night's swarm cards cannot attack.
Horde of Night's host card cannot be defeated. If it would be defeated, exhaust Horde of Night, instead.
cards.text_cn:
龐大。蜂擁1[per_investigator]。
夜色怪群的蜂擁卡牌不能攻擊。
夜色怪群的頭領卡牌不能被擊敗。如果其將被擊敗，改為消耗夜色怪群。

cards.name: Beings of Ib
cards.text: Prey - Investigator at a [[Ruins]] location only. Aloof. Hunter. Swarming 1 [per_investigator]. During the "enemy attacks" step of the enemy phase, instead of attacking its engaged investigator, Beings of Ib attacks each investigator at its location (even if it is unengaged).
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 僅限位於[[遺跡]]地點的調查員。 冷漠。獵手。蜂擁1[per_investigator]。 在敵軍階段的"敵人攻擊"步驟期間，伊伯生物不攻擊與其交戰的調查員，改為攻擊位於其地點的每位調查員(即便未與其交戰)。

cards.name: Priest of a Thousand Masks
cards.text:
While the investigators have uncovered...
...2 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
...4 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +2 health.
...6 or more Signs of the Gods, Priest of a Thousand Masks gets +1 damage and gains retaliate.
cards.text_cn:
調查員已經發現了……
……2個或更多的神跡時，千面祭司攻擊+1，躲避+1。
……4個或更多的神跡時，千面祭司生命值+2。
……6個或更多的神跡時，千面祭司傷害+1，並獲得反擊關鍵詞。

cards.name: Tenebrous Nightgaunt
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - When Tenebrous Nightgaunt leaves play as a result of an act's setup: Set it aside (it keeps all tokens and attachments). After resolving the act's setup, put it back into play at any [[City]] location.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 在黑暗夜魘因場景的設置而離場時：將其放在一邊(保留所有標記和疊加的卡牌)。結算場景的設置後，將其放回場上任意一個[[城市]]地點。

cards.name: Pack of Vooniths
cards.text:
Swarming 1.
While the host Pack of Vooniths has no attached swarm cards, it gets +2 fight and +2 evade.
cards.text_cn:
蜂擁1。
一群烏尼斯的頭領卡牌沒有疊加蜂擁卡牌時，其攻擊+2，躲避+2。

cards.name: Nightriders
cards.text: Swarming 1. While the host Nightriders has no attached swarm cards, it gets -3 evade. Forced - After you evade Nightriders: Discard it.
cards.text_cn: 蜂擁1。 夜騎的頭領卡牌沒有疊加蜂擁卡牌時，其躲避-3。 強制 - 在你躲避夜騎後：將其丟棄。

cards.name: Song of the Magah Bird
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you move out of attached location: Take 1 horror, place 1 doom on the current agenda, and discard Song of the Magah Bird. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance. [action]: Test [willpower] (4) to resist the call or [combat] (4) to drive away the birds. If you succeed, discard Song of the Magah Bird.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點。 強制 - 在你移動離開其疊加的地點後：受到1點恐懼、在當前的密謀上放置1個毀滅標記，並丟棄麥格鳥之歌。本效果可能導致當前密謀推進。 [action]：檢定[willpower](4)來抵禦呼喚，或者檢定[combat](4)來趕走鳥群。如果你檢定成功，丟棄麥格鳥之歌。

cards.name: Wondrous Lands
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no clues on your location, discard Wondrous Lands, and it gains surge. Otherwise, attach Wondrous Lands to your location. Attached location gets -2 shroud. Forced - After you successfully investigate attached location: Take 1 horror, place 1 doom on the current agenda, and discard Wondrous Lands. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果你所在地點上沒有線索，丟棄奇妙平原，其獲得湧動。否則，將奇妙平原疊加到你的地點。 疊加的地點隱藏值-2。 強制 - 在你成功調查疊加的地點後：受到1點恐懼、在當前的密謀上放置1個毀滅標記，並丟棄奇妙平原。本效果可能導致當前密謀推進。

cards.name: A Thousand Shapes of Horror
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at a [[Graveyard]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and The Unnamable is in play, it attacks you (regardless of its current location).
[tablet]: +2. The black cat causes a distraction. If this test is successful, choose and evade an enemy at any location with a fight value of X or lower, where X is the amount you succeeded by.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location or take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-1(如果你位於[[墓地]]地點，改為-3)。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗並且不可名狀之物在場，其攻擊你(無視其當前地點)。
[tablet]：+2。黑貓掩護你。如果本次檢定成功，選擇並躲避任意地點的、攻擊值不超過X的1個敵人，其中X等於你超過難度的點數。
[elder_thing]：-2。如果你檢定失敗，你必須將你的1個線索放在你所在地點上，或者受到1點傷害。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at a [[Graveyard]] location).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and The Unnamable is in play, it attacks you (regardless of its current location).
[tablet]: +1. The black cat causes a distraction. If this test is successful, choose and evade an enemy at any location with a fight value of X or lower, where X is the amount you succeeded by.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, you must either place 1 of your clues on your location or take 1 damage.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-2(如果你位於[[墓地]]地點，改為-4)。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗並且不可名狀之物在場，其攻擊你(無視其當前地點)。
[tablet]：+1。黑貓掩護你。如果本次檢定成功，選擇並躲避任意地點的、攻擊值不超過X的1個敵人，其中X等於你超過難度的點數。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你檢定失敗，你必須將你的1個線索放在你所在地點上，或者受到1點傷害。

cards.name: The Thing with No Name
cards.text: Each Swarm of Rats gains swarming 1. Forced - At the start of your turn, if The Unnamable is ready and at your location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, it attacks you (even if it is not engaged).
cards.text_cn: 每張鼠群獲得蜂擁1。 強制 - 當你的回合開始時，如果不可名狀之物已準備，並且位於你所在地點：檢定[willpower](2)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你(不論其是否交戰)。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Dead with No Name
cards.text: Each Swarm of Rats gains swarming 2. The Unnamable loses aloof and gains massive. Forced - At the start of your turn, if The Unnamable is ready and at your location: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, it attacks you (even if it is not engaged).
cards.text_cn: 每張鼠群獲得蜂擁2。 不可名狀之物失去冷漠關鍵詞，獲得龐大關鍵詞。 強制 - 當你的回合開始時，如果不可名狀之物已準備，並且位於你所在地點：檢定[willpower](2)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你(不論其是否交戰)。

cards.name: Searching the Unnamable
cards.text: Objective - Explore the house to find a way into the Dreamlands. (Find and complete an objective on another scenario card to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 探索這幢房子，以找到進入幻夢境的方法。(找到並完成另一張冒險卡上的目標來推進場景。)
cards.back_text: Set The Unnamable aside. It keeps all tokens and attachments. Remove each location from the game (or place it in the victory display if it has Victory X and no clues on it). Investigators are not defeated during this process. (Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded.) Shuffle the set-aside Mysterious Stairs locations and put 5 of them into play in a vertical line. Remove the remaining Mysterious Stairs location from the game. Place each investigator and the set-aside The Unnamable enemy at the topmost Mysterious Stairs location, revealing it. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for both copies of Locked Door and both copies of Secrets in the Attic, and remove them from the game. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Endless Descent into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 將不可名狀之物放在一邊。其保留所有標記和疊加的卡牌。 將所有地點移出遊戲(或者，如果地點帶有勝利X字樣並且上面沒有線索，將其放入勝利牌區)。調查員此進程期間不被擊敗。(丟棄這些地點上的其他敵人和疊加的卡牌。) 將放在一邊的"神秘階梯"地點混洗，將其中5張放置入場，擺成一條縱列。將剩餘的"神秘階梯"地點移出遊戲。 將每位調查員和放在一邊的"不可名狀之物"敵人放在最上方的"神秘階梯"地點，揭示該地點。 查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出2張"上鎖的門"和2張"閣樓的秘密"，將其移出遊戲。 將遭遇棄牌堆和放在一邊的所有"無盡深入"洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Endless Stairs
cards.text: While the bottommost Mysterious Stairs location is revealed, it gains: "[action]: Resign." Objective - Reach the bottom of the stairs. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: 最下方的"神秘階梯"地點被揭示時，其獲得："[action]：撤退。" 目標 - 到達階梯底部。如果所有未被擊敗的調查員均已撤退，推進場景。

cards.name: Burial Ground
cards.text:
Each [[Ghoul]] enemy drawn spawns at Burial Ground instead of at its normal location.
[fast] Investigators in the Burial Ground spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "noticed the missing bones."
cards.text_cn:
抽取到的每個[[食屍鬼]]敵人均不生成在原來的地點，改為生成在墳地。
[free]位於墳地的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：記住調查員"發現了缺失的骨頭"。

cards.name: Entryway
cards.text:
[fast] Investigators in the Entryway spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Reveal the Upstairs Hallway.
[fast] If The Unnamable has 1 [per_investigator] or more damage on it: Smoke trails off of the creature, leading to a tomb near the center of the cemetery outside. Put the set-aside Unmarked Tomb location into play.
cards.text_cn:
[free]位於入口的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：揭示樓上的走廊。
[free]如果不可名狀之物上有至少1[per_investigator]點傷害：那隻怪物拖著一道煙霧，煙霧的盡頭指向外頭墓地中央的一座墓穴。將放在一邊的無名墳墓地點放置入場。

cards.name: Den
cards.text:
[reaction] After you successfully investigate the Den, discard 1 card from your hand: Discover an additional clue at this location.
[fast] Investigators in the Den spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "studied a desecrated portrait."
cards.text_cn:
[reaction]在你成功調查休息間後，丟棄你的1張手牌：額外發現本地點的1個線索。
[free]位於休息間的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：記住調查員"研究了一幅褻瀆的肖像畫"。

cards.name: Parlor
cards.text:
For each investigator at the Parlor, it gets +1 shroud.
[fast] If The Unnamable has 2 [per_investigator] or more damage on it: The mirror gleams unnaturally, revealing a glint of silver. Remember that the investigators "recovered a strange key."
cards.text_cn:
每有1位調查員位於客廳，其隱藏值+1。
[free]如果不可名狀之物上有至少2[per_investigator]點傷害：鏡子不自然地閃著光芒，露出一抹銀光。記住調查員"發現了一把奇怪的鑰匙"。

cards.name: Upstairs Hallway
cards.text: [fast] Investigators in the Upstairs Hallway spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Put the set-aside Attic location into play.
cards.text_cn: [free]位於樓上的走廊的調查員以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：將放在一邊的閣樓地點放置入場。
cards.back_text: A malodorous presence prevents you from venturing upstairs. You cannot enter the Upstairs Hallway.
cards.back_text_cn: 惡臭讓你不敢上樓。你不能進入樓上的走廊。

cards.name: Library
cards.text:
As an additional cost to investigate the Library, you must either lose 1 action or take 1 horror.
[fast] Investigators in the Library spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: You read a strange journal entry regarding one of the graves in the burial ground outside. Put the set-aside Unmarked Tomb location into play.
cards.text_cn:
作為調查藏書室的額外費用，你必須失去1個行動或受到1點恐懼。
[free]位於藏書室的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：你翻閱了一篇古怪的日誌，提到外面墓地裡的一座墳墓。將放在一邊的無名墳墓地點放置入場。

cards.name: Bedroom
cards.text:
[action] [action]: Discard all non-weakness treachery cards from your threat area.
[fast] Investigators in the Bedroom spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "found a cracked mirror."
cards.text_cn:
[action][action]：棄掉你威脅區域的所有非弱點詭計卡牌。
[free]位於臥室的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：記住調查員"找到了破碎的鏡子"。

cards.name: Attic
cards.text: [fast] Investigators in the Attic spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deep within a pile of monstrous bones, you see a glint of silver. Remember that the investigators "recovered a strange key."
cards.text_cn: [free]位於閣樓的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：在一堆怪異的骨頭底下，你看到了一抹銀光。記住調查員"發現了一把奇怪的鑰匙"。

cards.name: Unmarked Tomb
cards.text: Objective - At the end of the round, if each undefeated investigator is at Unmarked Tomb and the investigators "recovered a strange key," advance the act.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 當一輪結束時，如果所有未被擊敗的調查員都位於無名墳墓，並且調查員"發現了一把奇怪的鑰匙"，推進場景。

cards.name: Mysterious Stairs
cards.text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. Forced - After you enter this location: Lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。 強制 - 在你進入本地點後：失去1次行動。
cards.back_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
cards.back_text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。

cards.name: Mysterious Stairs
cards.text:
Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
While there are clues on this location, investigators at this location cannot move or resign.
cards.text_cn:
神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。
本地點上有線索時，位於本地點的調查員不能移動，也不能撤退。
cards.back_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
cards.back_text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。

cards.name: Mysterious Stairs
cards.text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. While there is a ready enemy at this location, investigators at this location cannot move or resign. Forced - When this location is revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Ghoul]] enemy and spawn it at this location. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。 本地點上有準備狀態的敵人時，位於本地點的調查員不能移動，也不能撤退。 強制 - 在本地點翻開時：查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出1張[[食屍鬼]]敵人，將其生成在本地點。混洗遭遇牌堆。
cards.back_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
cards.back_text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。

cards.name: Mysterious Stairs
cards.text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. Forced - When this location is revealed: Place 1 [per_investigator] resources on it. While there are resources on this location, investigators at this location cannot move or resign. [action]: Test your lowest skill (2). If successful, discard 1 resource from this location.
cards.text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。 強制 - 在本地點翻開時：在本地點上放置1[per_investigator]資源。本地點上有資源時，位於本地點的調查員不能移動，也不能撤退。 [action]：檢定你技能值最低的技能(2)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄本地點的1資源。
cards.back_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
cards.back_text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。

cards.name: Mysterious Stairs
cards.text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it. Forced - When this location is revealed: Move The Unnamable to it. While The Unnamable is at this location and has fewer than 1 [per_investigator] damage on it, investigators at this location cannot move or resign.
cards.text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。 強制 - 在本地點翻開時：將不可名狀之物移動到本地點。 不可名狀之物位於本地點，且其受到的傷害點數少於1[per_investigator]時，位於本地點的調查員不能移動，也不能撤退。
cards.back_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
cards.back_text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。

cards.name: Mysterious Stairs
cards.text:
Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
As an additional cost for you to move or resign at this location, you must discard 1 or more cards from your hand with at least 2 instances of the same skill icon among them.
cards.text_cn:
神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。
作為你在本地點上移動或撤退的額外費用，你必須丟棄你至少1張手牌，且棄掉的手牌中必須有至少2個相同的技能圖標。
cards.back_text: Mysterious Stairs is connected to the locations above and below it.
cards.back_text_cn: 神秘階梯與其上方和下方的地點連接。

cards.name: The Silver Key
cards.text: [reaction] When you would take horror, exhaust The Silver Key: Cancel 1 of that horror.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你將要受到恐懼時，消耗銀鑰匙：取消該恐懼中的1點。

meta.subname: Key to the Gate of Dreams

cards.name: Endless Descent
cards.text: Revelation - Move each investigator and enemy at the topmost location to the location below it. Flip the topmost location to its unrevealed side, discard all tokens and attachments from it, and place it below the bottommost location. Shuffle the positions of each unrevealed location so you cannot tell which is which. Add this card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將位於最上方地點的所有調查員和敵人移動到其連接的下方地點。將最上方的地點翻面至未揭示面，棄掉其所有標記和疊加的卡牌，將其放到最下方的地點下方。將所有未揭示的地點混洗以打亂位置，使你無法辨認。將本卡牌加入勝利牌區。

cards.name: Indescribable Apparition
cards.text: Revelation - Put Indescribable Apparition into play in your threat area. You get -1 to each of your skills while The Unnamable is at your location. [action] [action]: Discard Indescribable Apparition.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將難以描述的鬼魅放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 不可名狀之物位於你所在地點時，你每項技能值-1。 [action][action]：丟棄難以描述的鬼魅。

cards.name: Glowing Eyes
cards.text: Revelation - Put Glowing Eyes into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of the round: Take 1 horror for each card in your threat area, to a maximum of 3 horror. Discard Glowing Eyes.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將發光的眼睛放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：你威脅區域每有1張卡牌，受到1點恐懼，最多受到3點恐懼。丟棄發光的眼睛。

cards.name: Deceptive Memories
cards.text: Revelation - Put Deceptive Memories into play in your threat area. Forced - After another card enters your threat area: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Deceptive Memories.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將欺騙性記憶放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 強制 - 在有另外的卡牌進入你的威脅區域後：選擇並丟棄你1張手牌。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄欺騙性記憶。

cards.name: Secrets in the Attic
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror and put Secrets in the Attic into play next to the agenda deck. [fast] abilities on locations cannot be triggered. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Secrets in the Attic from play. (Max once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點恐懼，將閣樓的秘密放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁邊。 地點上的[free]能力不能觸發。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：從場上丟棄1張閣樓的秘密。(每輪最多1次。)

cards.name: Dark Side of the Moon
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half your alarm level (rounded up).
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and your alarm level is higher than your modified skill value, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -1. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[elder_thing]: +1. The black cat summons several other cats to help. If this token is revealed during an evasion attempt and you succeed, deal 2 damage to the evaded enemy.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X，等於你的警報等級的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗，且你的警報等級高於你修正後的技能值，在本次檢定結束後，抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。
[tablet]：-1。如果你檢定失敗，你的警報等級提高1級。
[elder_thing]：+1。黑貓召喚了幾隻貓來幫你。如果在躲避嘗試期間抽出這個標記，且你檢定成功，對躲避的敵人造成2點傷害。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is your alarm level.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and your alarm level is higher than your modified skill value, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
[elder_thing]: 0. The black cat summons several other cats to help. If this token is revealed during an evasion attempt and you succeed, deal 2 damage to the evaded enemy.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X，X等於你的警報等級。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗，且你的警報等級高於你修正後的技能值，在本次檢定結束後，抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。
[tablet]：-2。如果你檢定失敗，你的警報等級提高1級。
[elder_thing]：0。黑貓召喚了幾隻貓來幫你。如果在躲避嘗試期間抽出這個標記，且你檢定成功，對躲避的敵人造成2點傷害。

cards.name: Silent Stirring
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
每位調查員的警報等級提高1級。

cards.name: The Alarm Is Raised
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
Check Campaign Log. If the investigators forced their way into the temple, read the following:
...but nobody comes.
 The lead investigator searches the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Cats from Saturn and draws it.
Otherwise, read the following:
...and to your surprise, an army of cats lands in front of you, having leaped through the void of space itself. You recognize the cat at the head of the formation as the grey old cat with the scar you met months ago. "Go, human!" he yells. "We will hold them off!"
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。 每位調查員的警報等級提高1級。
查看冒險日誌。如果調查員強行進入神廟，閱讀以下文字：
……但沒人來救你。
 調查員隊長查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出1張土星貓，並將其抽取。
否則，閱讀以下文字：
……突然，一大群貓咪從虛空躍出，落在你身前，讓你驚訝不已。你認出為首的貓咪正是你在數月之前見過的傷疤老灰貓。"快走，人類！"它大喊，"我們來對付它們！"

cards.name: They Are Upon You!
cards.text: (Hint - The game will not end when this agenda advances... but the agents of Nyarlathotep will tighten their noose.)
cards.text_cn: (提示：本密謀推進時本場遊戲不會結束……但奈亞拉托提普的使徒們會收緊它們的圈套。)
cards.back_text:
Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1.
Each investigator takes horror equal to half their alarm level (rounded up).
Reset the agenda deck to agenda 3a. Then, place 2 doom on that agenda.
cards.back_text_cn:
每位調查員的警報等級提高1級。
每位調查員受到等於其警報等級一半的恐懼(向上取整)。
將密謀牌堆重置為密謀3a。然後，在該密謀上放置2個毀滅標記。

cards.name: In the Belly of the Moon-Beast
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators at the City of the Moon-Beasts may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有位於月獸之城的調查員可以以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: Choose an investigator at the City of the Moon-Beasts to take control of the set-aside Virgil Gray (Truly Inspired) story asset. Check Campaign Log: If Randolph was captured, that card's owner puts the set-aside Randolph Carter (Expert Dreamer) story asset into their hand.
cards.back_text_cn: 選擇位於月獸之城的一位調查員來控制放在一邊的維吉爾·格雷(文思泉湧))劇情支援。 查看冒險日誌。如果倫道夫被俘，該卡的所有者將放在一邊的倫道夫·卡特(夢境專家)劇情支援放入手牌。

cards.name: Exploring the Moon
cards.text: Objective - Only investigators at the Temple of the Moon Lizard may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 只有位於月蜥神廟的調查員可以以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: Put the set-aside Caverns Beneath the Moon (Dark Side) and The Black Core locations into play. Spawn the set-aside Moon Lizard at The Black Core, exhausted. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的月下洞穴(暗面)和黑暗月核地點放置入場。 將放在一邊的月蜥生成在黑暗月核，呈消耗狀態。 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Moon's Core
cards.text: Clues cannot be discovered from The Black Core except as a result of a successful investigation. Objective - If each surviving investigator is at The Black Core and it has no clues on it, advance.
cards.text_cn: 黑暗月核的線索只能通過調查成功來發現，其他方式均不能發現。 目標 -如果每位存活的調查員都位於黑暗月核，且黑暗月核上沒有線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Put the set-aside Caverns Beneath the Moon (Light Side), Light Side of the Moon, and The White Ship locations into play.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的月下洞穴(亮面)、月之亮面、白船地點放置入場。

cards.name: Unexpected Rescue
cards.text: Objective - Find a way off the Moon. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 設法離開月球。(你將會收到指示，告訴你何時推進場景。)

cards.name: Moon-Beast Galley
cards.text: Investigators cannot enter or leave Moon-Beast Galley via player card effects. [fast] If there are no clues remaining on Moon-Beast Galley: Flip it over. Forced - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play: Flip Moon-Beast Galley over.
cards.text_cn: 調查員不能通過玩家卡的效果進入或離開月獸帆船。 [free]如果月獸帆船上沒有線索：將其翻面。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果場上有至少3個毀滅標記：將月獸帆船翻面。

cards.name: City of the Moon-Beasts
cards.text: X is the highest alarm level among all investigators. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at the City of the Moon-Beasts tests [agility] (2). Each investigator who fails must raise their alarm level by 1.
cards.text_cn: X為所有調查員之中最高的警報等級。 強制 - 當一輪結束時：位於月獸之城每位調查員檢定[agility](2)。每位檢定失敗的調查員必須將自己的警報等級提高1。

cards.name: The Dark Crater
cards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] (5) to hide within the crater. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) Forced - At the end of your turn, if you are at The Dark Crater and have discovered 1 or more of its clues this turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[intellect](5)以躲在坑裡。如果你檢定成功，你的警報等級下降1級。(本成功效果每場遊戲限制一次。) 強制 - 當你回合結束時，如果你位於漆黑深坑，並且你在本回合發現了本卡牌至少1個線索：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定失敗，你的警報等級提高1級。

cards.name: Temple of the Moon Lizard
cards.text: [action]: Test [willpower] (5) to hide inside the forbidden temple. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) Forced - After you discover any number of clues at the Temple of the Moon Lizard: You must either take that much horror or discard that many cards from your hand.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[willpower](5)以躲在禁閉的神廟裡。如果你檢定成功，你的警報等級下降1級。(本成功效果每場遊戲限制一次。) 強制 - 在你發現月蜥神廟的任意數量的線索後：你必須受到相同數量的恐懼，或者棄掉相同數量的手牌。

cards.name: Moon-Forest
cards.text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to hide among the strange trees. If you succeed, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit 1 success per game.) [fast] During your turn, except during another action: Evade. If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[agility](5)以藏身在怪異的森林中。如果你檢定成功，你的警報等級下降1級。(本成功效果每場遊戲限制一次。) [free]在你回合期間(行動外)：躲避。如果你檢定失敗，你的警報等級提高1級。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Caverns Beneath the Moon
cards.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Caverns Beneath the Moon: Until the end of your turn, reduce its shroud by 2.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你調查月下洞穴時，在技能檢定失敗後：其隱藏值-2，直到你回合結束。

cards.name: The Black Core
cards.text: X is the number of depth tokens on The Black Core. Forced - After The Black Core is revealed: Place 3 resources on it, as depth tokens, plus an additional 3 [per_investigator] depth tokens. [action]: Test [willpower] (2) or [combat] (2) to swim through the dark lake at the Moon's core. For each point you succeed by, remove 1 depth token from The Black Core.
cards.text_cn: X為黑暗月核上的深度標記數量。 強制 - 在黑暗月核揭示後：在本地點放置3個資源作為深度標記，再額外加上3[per_investigator]個深度標記。 [action]：檢定[willpower](2)或[combat](2)來遊過月核的黑水湖。你成功且每超過難度1點，移除黑暗月核的1個深度標記。
cards.back_text: The path to the Moon's core is long and winding. You cannot enter The Black Core while Caverns Beneath the Moon (Dark Side) has clues on it.
cards.back_text_cn: 通往月球核心的道路漫長而曲折。當月下洞穴 (暗面)上有線索時，你不能進入黑暗月核。

cards.name: Caverns Beneath the Moon
cards.text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Caverns Beneath the Moon: Until the end of your turn, reduce its shroud by 2.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你調查月下洞穴時，在技能檢定失敗後：其隱藏值-2，直到你回合結束。

cards.name: Light Side of the Moon
cards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] (1) or [agility] (1) to attempt to hide among the ruins. For every 3 points you succeed by, reduce your alarm level by 1. (Limit one success per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[intellect](1)或[agility](1)來藏身在廢墟之中。你成功且每超過難度3點，你的警報等級下降1級。(本成功效果每輪限制一次。)
cards.back_text: The path to the Moon's surface is long and winding. You cannot enter Light Side of the Moon while Caverns Beneath the Moon (Light Side) has clues on it.
cards.back_text_cn: 通往月球表面的道路漫長而曲折。當月下洞穴(亮面)上有線索時，你不能進入月之亮面。

cards.name: The White Ship
cards.text: You cannot enter The White Ship while your alarm level is 5 or higher. Forced - After The White Ship is revealed: Put the set-aside The Captain story asset into play at The White Ship.
cards.text_cn: 你的警報等級至少為5時，你不能進入白船。 強制 - 在白船揭示後：將放在一邊的船長劇情支援卡放置入場，放到白船上。
cards.back_text: The mysterious ship's captain cannot let you board until the pursuing moon-beasts have retreated. You cannot enter The White Ship while your alarm level is 5 or higher.
cards.back_text_cn: 這艘神秘帆船的船長不允許你登船，除非追趕你的月獸均已撤退。你的警報等級至少為5時，你不能進入白船。

cards.name: Virgil Gray
cards.text: [reaction] After your alarm level is raised: Either draw 1 card, gain 1 resource, or heal 1 horror from Virgil Gray. If there is more than 1 investigator in the game, give control of Virgil Gray to another investigator. Forced - If Virgil Gray leaves play: Remove him from the game.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你的警報等級提高後：抽取1張卡牌、獲得1個資源或治癒維吉爾·格雷的1點恐懼。如果有超過1位調查員進行本場遊戲，將維吉爾·格雷的控制權交給另一位調查員。 強制 - 如果維吉爾·格雷離場：將其移出遊戲。(FAQ, v2.0)

cards.name: The Captain
cards.text: [action] If each undefeated investigator is at The White Ship: Parley. Test [willpower] (X) or [intellect] (X) to convince the captain to set sail. X is the highest alarm level among the investigators. If you succeed, advance the act. Any investigator at The White Ship may activate this ability.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果所有未被擊敗的調查員均位於白船：談判。檢定[willpower](X)或[intellect](X)以說服船長啟航，其中X為所有調查員之中最高的警報等級。如果你檢定成功，推進場景。位於白船的任何調查員都可以啟動此能力。

cards.name: Moon Lizard
cards.text:
Hunter.
Moon Lizard can only enter [[Cave]] locations.
While Moon Lizard is engaged with an investigator, X is that investigator's alarm level. Otherwise, X is 5.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
月蜥只能進入[[洞穴]]地點。
月蜥與調查員交戰時，X等於該調查員的警報等級。否則，X等於5。

cards.name: Moonbound Byakhee
cards.text: Spawn - Nearest [[Surface]] location. Prey - Highest alarm level (3 or more only). Alert. Hunter. While moving or engaging, Moonbound Byakhee ignores investigators with an alarm level of 2 or less.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 最近的[[月面]]地點。 獵物 - 警報等級最高並且至少為3的目標。 警戒。獵手。 月之拜亞基移動或交戰時，其忽略警報等級小於等於2的調查員。

cards.name: Cats from Saturn
cards.text: Hunter. Swarming X. X is your alarm level (or the highest alarm level among investigators if there is no active investigator). Forced - After the host Cats from Saturn moves or is evaded: Discard 1 of its swarm cards.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。蜂擁X。 X等於你的警報等級。(如果此時非調查階段，則X等於所有調查員中最高的警報等級)。 強制 - 在土星貓的頭領移動或被躲避後：丟棄其1張蜂擁卡牌。

cards.name: Moon-Beast
cards.text: Retaliate. Forced - After Moon-Beast enters play: Raise each investigator's alarm level by 1. Forced - After you defeat Moon-Beast: Reduce each investigator's alarm level by 1.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 強制 - 在月獸入場後：每位調查員的警報等級提高1級。 強制 - 在你擊敗月獸後：每位調查員的警報等級降低1級。

cards.name: Close Watch
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (4). If you fail, you must either discard the asset you control with the highest printed cost, or raise your alarm level by 1.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](4)。如果你檢定失敗，你必須丟棄你控制的打印費用最高的支援，或者將你的警報等級提高1級。

cards.name: Forced into Hiding
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your alarm level. - If you fail, lose 1 action. - If you fail by 3 or more, lose 2 actions instead. - If you fail by 5 or more, lose 3 actions instead.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](X)，其中X等於你的警報等級。 - 如果你檢定失敗，失去1次行動。 - 如果你失敗且低於難度至少3點，改為失去2個行動。 - 你失敗且低於難度至少5點，改為失去3個行動。

cards.name: Lunar Patrol
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. [action]: Test [agility] (3) to lose the patrol. If you succeed, discard Lunar Patrol. Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Raise that investigator's alarm level by 1.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點。 [action]：檢定[agility](3)以避開巡邏。如果你檢定成功，丟棄月球巡邏。 強制 - 在一位調查員離開疊加地點時：該調查員的警報等級提高1級。

cards.name: False Awakening
cards.text:
False Awakening begins each game next to the agenda deck, with 1 doom on it.
[action]: Test any skill (2). This test gets +1 [per_investigator] difficulty. If you succeed, remove False Awakening from the game. Any investigator may trigger this ability.
cards.text_cn:
每場遊戲開始時，將夢中甦醒放在密謀牌堆旁邊，並在夢中甦醒上放置1個毀滅標記。
[action]：檢定任意技能(2)。本次檢定難度+1[per_investigator]。如果你檢定成功，將夢中甦醒移出遊戲。任何調查員都可以觸發本能力。

cards.name: Point of No Return
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the amount of damage on this card.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: +1. The black cat helps you navigate through the death-fire. If this token is revealed during an investigation and you succeed, draw 1 card.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail by 2 or more, choose a ready enemy at your location or a connecting location. That enemy moves to your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X等於本卡牌上的傷害數量。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗，在本次技能檢定失敗後，抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。
[tablet]：+1。黑貓帶你走出了死亡之火。如果本標記是在調查期間抽出的，並且你檢定成功，抽取1張卡牌。
[elder_thing]：-3。如果你檢定失敗並低於難度至少2點，選擇你所在地點或連接地點的1個準備狀態的敵人。該敵人移動到你的地點，與你交戰並立即攻擊你。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the amount of damage on this card.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, after this skill test ends, draw the top card of the encounter deck.
[tablet]: 0. The black cat helps you navigate through the death-fire. If this token is revealed during an investigation and you succeed, draw 1 card.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail by 2 or more, choose a ready enemy at your location or a connecting location. That enemy moves to your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X等於本卡牌上的傷害數量+1。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗，在本次技能檢定失敗後，抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。
[tablet]：0。黑貓帶你走出了死亡之火。如果本標記是在調查期間抽出的，並且你檢定成功，抽取1張卡牌。
[elder_thing]：-4。如果你檢定失敗並低於難度至少2點，選擇你所在地點或連接地點的1個準備狀態的敵人。該敵人移動到你的地點，與你交戰並立即攻擊你。

cards.name: A Sinister Realm
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Place 1 damage on the scenario reference card.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。
在冒險輔助卡上放置1個傷害標記。

cards.name: Beset by Monsters
cards.text: (Hint - The game will not necessarily end when this agenda advances... but the stability of reality will continue to unravel.)
cards.text_cn: (提示：本密謀推進時本場遊戲不會結束……但現實的結構會進一步崩解。)
cards.back_text: Each investigator must either discard 1 card at random from their hand or lose 2 resources. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Place 1 damage on the scenario reference card. Then: - If there are 5 or more damage tokens on the scenario reference card, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, flip this agenda back over.
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員必須隨機丟棄自己的1張手牌，或者失去2資源。 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。 在冒險輔助卡上放置1個傷害標記。然後： - 如果冒險輔助卡上的傷害數大於等於5，進入(→結局2)。 - 否則，將本密謀翻面。

cards.name: Entering the Underworld (v. I)
cards.text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Explore this region. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在擊敗帶有線索的敵人後：控制該敵人的所有線索。 目標 - 探索這片區域。(你將會收到指示，告訴你何時推進場景。)
cards.back_text: Put each set-aside [[Vale]] location into play. Find each card from the Ghouls encounter set and the Striking Fear encounter set (even if they are out of play). Remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Terror of the Vale and Nightgaunts encounter sets into the encounter deck, along with the discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的每個[[山谷]]地點放置入場。 找出食尸鬼遭遇組和恐懼打擊遭遇組的每張卡牌(即使位於場外)。將其移出遊戲。 將放在一邊的恐怖谷和夜魘遭遇組和遭遇棄牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Entering the Underworld (v. II)
cards.text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find Richard Upton Pickman. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在擊敗帶有線索的敵人後：控制該敵人的所有線索。 目標 - 找到理查德·厄普頓·皮克曼。(你將會收到指示，告訴你何時推進場景。)
cards.back_text: Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Richard Upton Pickman story asset. For the remainder of the scenario, if Richard Upton Pickman leaves play, remove him from the game. Put each set-aside [[Vale]] location into play. Find each card from the Striking Fear encounter set (even if they are out of play). Remove them from the game. Shuffle the set-aside Terror of the Vale and Nightgaunts encounter sets into the encounter deck, along with the discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 選擇一位調查員來控制放在一邊的理查德·厄普頓·皮克曼劇情支援。在本場冒險結束之前，如果理查德·厄普頓·皮克曼離場，將其移出遊戲。 將放在一邊的每個[[山谷]]地點放置入場。 找出恐懼打擊遭遇組的每張卡牌(即使位於場外)。將其移出遊戲。 將放在一邊的恐怖谷和夜魘遭遇組和遭遇棄牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Descent
cards.text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find the way to the Sea of Pitch. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在擊敗帶有線索的敵人後：控制該敵人的所有線索。 目標 - 找到前往漆黑之海的道路。(你將會收到指示，告訴你何時推進場景。)
cards.back_text: Put each set-aside [[Depths]] location into play. Shuffle the set-aside Descent into the Pitch and Agents of Atlach-Nacha encounter sets into the encounter deck, along with the discard pile.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的每個[[深海]]地點放置入場。 將放在一邊的深入漆黑之海和阿特拉克·納克亞的使徒遭遇組和遭遇棄牌堆一起洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Black Expanse
cards.text: Forced - After an enemy with 1 or more clues on it is defeated: Take control of each of those clues. Objective - Find the source of the distortion. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在擊敗帶有線索的敵人後：控制這些線索。(FAQ, v1.9) 目標 - 找到地下世界扭曲的根源。(你將會收到指示，告訴你何時推進場景。)

cards.name: Vaults of Zin
cards.text: Veiled.
cards.text_cn: 掩藏。

cards.name: City of Gugs
cards.text: Forced - After you enter City of Gugs: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入古革巨人之城後：將其翻至另一面並且結算該面的文字。

cards.name: Tower of Koth
cards.text: [action]: Test [combat] (5) to lift the heavy stone trapdoor at the top of the tower. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[combat](5)以移開塔頂沉重的石板暗門。如果你檢定成功，將本卡牌翻面並且結算該面的文字。

cards.name: Plain of the Ghouls
cards.text:
Veiled.
[[Gug]] enemies cannot enter the Plain of the Ghouls. If a [[Gug]] enemy would spawn at the Plain of the Ghouls, spawn it at the City of Gugs instead.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
[[古革巨人]]敵人不能進入食尸鬼平原。如果[[古革巨人]]敵人將要生成在食尸鬼平原，改為將其生成在古革巨人之城。

cards.name: Crag of the Ghouls
cards.text:
Veiled.
The first treachery drawn during the mythos phase by an investigator at this location gains surge.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
本地點的調查員在神話階段期間抽出的第一張詭計卡獲得湧動。

cards.name: Sea of Bones
cards.text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Sea of Bones: Flip it over.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你在骸骨之海發現至少1個線索後：將其翻面。

cards.name: Peaks of Thok
cards.text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to attempt to scale the treacherous peaks. If you succeed, flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When you leave Peaks of Thok: You must test [agility] (2) to climb down safely. If you fail, take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[agility](5)以嘗試攀登危險的山峰。如果你檢定成功，將本卡牌翻至另一面並且結算該面的文字。 強制 - 在你離開撒克山峰時：你必須檢定[agility](2)以安全地爬下山峰。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Vale of Pnath
cards.text:
Veiled.
While there are clues remaining on Vale of Pnath, investigators at Vale of Pnath cannot play cards or commit cards to skill tests.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
潘斯山谷上有線索時，位於潘斯山谷的調查員不能打出卡牌，也不能投入卡牌到技能檢定中。

cards.name: Sea of Pitch
cards.text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
X為冒險輔助卡上的傷害標記數。

cards.name: Sea of Pitch
cards.text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
X為冒險輔助卡上的傷害標記數。
