cards.text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
X為冒險輔助卡上的傷害標記數。

cards.name: Sea of Pitch
cards.text:
Veiled.
X is the number of damage tokens on the scenario reference card.
cards.text_cn:
掩藏。
X為冒險輔助卡上的傷害標記數。

cards.name: Richard Upton Pickman
cards.text: [fast] Exhaust Richard Upton Pickman: Choose a [[Ghoul]] enemy at your location and attach it to him, facedown. [action] Exhaust Richard Upton Pickman: Fight. You attack with a base [combat] of 5. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals damage equal to the number of facedown encounter cards attached to Richard Upton Pickman.
cards.text_cn: [free]消耗理查德·厄普頓·皮克曼：選擇你所在地點的一個[[食屍鬼]]敵人將其正面朝下疊加到理查德·厄普頓·皮克曼。 [action]消耗理查德·厄普頓·皮克曼：攻擊。 以基礎值為5點的[combat]來進行攻擊。本次攻擊不造成其基礎傷害，改為造成X點傷害，其中X等於疊加到理查德·厄普頓·皮克曼的正面朝下的遭遇牌數量。

cards.name: Gug Sentinel
cards.text: Gug Sentinel gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Gug Sentinel readies: Deal 1 horror to each investigator at its location.
cards.text_cn: 古革哨兵生命值+2[per_investigator]。 強制 - 在古革哨兵準備後：對其所在地點的每位調查員造成1點恐懼。

cards.name: Taste of Lifeblood
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, you must (choose one): Place 1 of your clues on your location, place 1 of your clues on the nearest enemy, or take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。你失敗且每低於難度1點，必須選擇以下一項：將你的1個線索放在你所在地點或者最近的敵人上，或者受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Lit by Death-Fire
cards.text: Revelation - Each investigator loses 1 resource. Each investigator at a [[Vale]] or [[Depths]] location chooses and discards 1 card from their hand. Each investigator at a [[Depths]] location loses 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 每位調查員失去1資源。位於[[山谷]]或[[深海]]地點的每位調查員選擇並棄掉自己的1張手牌。位於[[深海]]地點的每位調查員失去1個行動。

cards.name: Unexpected Ambush
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no enemies in play, take 1 damage and 1 horror. Otherwise, test [intellect] (4) or [agility] (4). If you fail, the nearest enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, and engages you. Then, if you failed by 3 or more, it makes an immediate attack.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 -如果場上沒有敵人，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。否則，檢定[intellect](4)或[agility](4)。如果你檢定失敗，最近的敵人準備並移動(每次移動1個地點)，直到其到達你所在地點並與你交戰。然後，如果你檢定失敗並低於難度至少3點，其立即攻擊你。

cards.name: Slithering Dhole
cards.text: Spawn - Nearest location with an attached Dhole Tunnel. (Otherwise, shuffle Slithering Dhole back into the encounter deck, and it gains surge.) Hunter. Massive. While Slithering Dhole is moving, all locations with an attached Dhole Tunnel are considered to be connected to one another.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 最近的疊加有巨噬蠕蟲隧道的地點。(否則，將滑行的巨噬蠕蟲洗回遭遇牌堆，其獲得湧動。) 獵手。龐大。 滑行的巨噬蠕蟲移動時，疊加有巨噬蠕蟲隧道的所有地點視作彼此相連。

cards.name: Dhole Tunnel
cards.text: Revelation - If Slithering Dhole is in play, it moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase. Otherwise, attach Dhole Tunnel to a location at least 2 connections away from the nearest Dhole Tunnel (or to your location if you cannot). Then, if Slithering Dhole is in the victory display, spawn it at attached location, exhausted.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 -如果滑行的巨噬蠕蟲在場上，其移動並攻擊，如同在敵軍階段。否則，將巨噬蠕蟲隧道疊加到與最近的巨噬蠕蟲隧道之間連接次數至少為2的一個地點(如果你不能這麼做，則疊加到你所在地點)。然後，如果滑行的巨噬蠕蟲在勝利牌區，將其生成在本卡牌疊加的地點，呈消耗狀態。

cards.name: Pitch Spider
cards.text: Spawn - Any Sea of Pitch location (empty, if able). Swarming X. X is the amount of damage on the scenario reference card. Forced - When Pitch Spider attacks you: It deals either its damage or its horror, instead of both.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個漆黑之海地點(如果可能的話，選擇無人的漆黑之海地點)。 蜂擁X。其中X為冒險輔助卡上的傷害數量。 強制 - 在漆黑蜘蛛攻擊你時：其不同時造成傷害和恐懼，而是改為造成其中一項。

cards.name: Shadow of Atlach-Nacha
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each damage on the scenario reference card. If you fail, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。冒險輔助卡上每有1點傷害，本次檢定難度+1。如果你檢定失敗，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼。

cards.name: False Awakening
cards.text:
False Awakening begins each game next to the agenda deck, with 1 doom on it.
[action]: Test any skill (2). This test gets +1 [per_investigator] difficulty. If you succeed, remove False Awakening from the game. Any investigator may trigger this ability.
cards.text_cn:
每場遊戲開始時，將夢中甦醒放在密謀牌堆旁邊，並在夢中甦醒上放置1個毀滅標記。
[action]：檢定任意技能(2)。本次檢定難度+1[per_investigator]。如果你檢定成功，將夢中甦醒移出遊戲。任何調查員都可以觸發本能力。

cards.name: Where the Gods Dwell
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of the current act.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current agenda.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, choose and reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep in your hand. It attacks you and is shuffled into the encounter deck.
[elder_thing]: 0. The black cat reminds you that it's all a dream.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：-X。其中X等於當前場景編號。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗，在當前的密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。
[tablet]：-4。如果你檢定失敗，選擇並揭示你手中的1張奈亞拉托提普。其攻擊你，將其洗入遭遇牌堆。
[elder_thing]：0。黑貓提醒你這一切都是一場夢。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of the current act plus the number of the current agenda.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect may cause the current agenda to advance.
[tablet]: -6. If you fail, choose and reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep in your hand. It attacks you and is shuffled into the encounter deck.
[elder_thing]: -1. The black cat reminds you that it's all a dream.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：-X。其中X等於當前場景編號加上當前密謀編號。
[cultist]：再抽出1個標記。如果你檢定失敗，在當前的密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。本效果可能導致當前密謀推進。
[tablet]：-6。如果你檢定失敗，選擇並揭示你手中的1張奈亞拉托提普。其攻擊你，將其洗入遭遇牌堆。
[elder_thing]：-1。黑貓提醒你這一切都是一場夢。

cards.name: The Eye of Chaos
cards.back_text: If it is act 4, read the following: Place clues on each Forsaken Tower location until it has clues equal to its clue value. Reveal each copy of Nyarlathotep in each investigator's hand. Each investigator who did not reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep must take either 1 damage or 1 horror. For each copy of Nyarlathotep revealed by an investigator, that investigator must choose: - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator and is shuffled into the encounter deck. - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator three times and is returned to that investigator's hand.
cards.back_text_cn: 如果當前場景為場景4，閱讀以下文字： 在每張被遺忘的高塔地點上放置線索，直到其線索數量等於其線索值。 每位調查員揭示自己手牌中所有的奈亞拉托提普。沒有揭示奈亞拉托提普的每位調查員必須受到1點傷害或1點恐懼。每位調查員每揭示1張奈亞拉托提普，該調查員必須選擇： - 奈亞拉托提普立即攻擊該調查員，並洗入遭遇牌堆。 - 奈亞拉托提普立即攻擊該調查員3次，並返回該調查員手牌。

cards.name: The Shape of Chaos
cards.back_text: If it is act 4, read the following: Place clues on each Forsaken Tower location until it has clues equal to its clue value. Reveal each copy of Nyarlathotep in each investigator's hand. Each investigator who did not reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep must take either 1 damage or 1 horror. For each copy of Nyarlathotep revealed by an investigator, that investigator must choose: - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator and is shuffled into the encounter deck. - Nyarlathotep immediately attacks that investigator three times and is returned to that investigator's hand.
cards.back_text_cn: 如果當前場景為場景4，閱讀以下文字： 在每張被遺忘的高塔地點上放置線索，直到其線索數量等於其線索值。 每位調查員揭示自己手牌中所有的奈亞拉托提普。沒有揭示奈亞拉托提普的每位調查員必須受到1點傷害或1點恐懼。每位調查員每揭示1張奈亞拉托提普，該調查員必須選擇： - 奈亞拉托提普立即攻擊該調查員，並洗入遭遇牌堆。 - 奈亞拉托提普立即攻擊該調查員3次，並返回該調查員手牌。

cards.name: Chaos Incarnate
cards.back_text: Each investigator is defeated and driven insane.
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員均被擊敗，並且發瘋。

cards.name: Journey Through the Cold Wastes
cards.back_text:
Reveal the Monastery of Leng.
Spawn the set-aside High Priest Not to Be Described enemy in the Monastery of Leng.
cards.back_text_cn:
揭示冷原隱修院。
將放在一邊的不可描述的高階祭司敵人生成在冷原隱修院。

cards.name: The Thing in the Robes
cards.text: [action] If an investigator "maneuvered the priest closer," and an investigator "stunned the priest": Defeat the High Priest Not to Be Described. Objective - If the High Priest Not to Be Described is defeated, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果調查員"靠近了祭司"並且調查員"打暈了祭司"：擊敗不可描述的高階祭司。 目標 -如果不可描述的高階祭司被擊敗，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If you defeated the High Priest Not to Be Described with damage, read the following:
As you strike it down, the creature spits foul curses at you in tongues that can scarcely be described. Its last breath is filled with hate.
If you defeated the High Priest Not to Be Described using the ability on act 2a, read the following:
Despite your fear - or perhaps as a result - you discover a means to escape the creature's grasp. With the creature distracted, you shove with all of your might, and it topples into the gaping well in the center of the room, letting out a hideous screech in its wake.
No matter how it was defeated, also read the following:
With the monster dispatched, you can explore its monastery in relative peace. Along the ruined walls of the stone building, tapestries depict the history of this land, a history of blood and suffering that you have no desire to remember when this is all said and done. Great snowcapped peaks loom over each of these scenes. In just one of them, a castle is woven in black thread.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果你通過傷害擊敗了不可描述的高階祭司，閱讀以下文字：
你打倒這頭怪物時，它以一種難以描述的語言詛咒你。它嚥下了滿懷仇恨的最後一口氣。
如果你通過使用場景2a的能力擊敗了不可描述的高階祭司，閱讀以下文字：
儘管你內心恐懼——或者說，正是因為你的恐懼——你找到了逃離這頭怪物魔掌的方法。你趁著它不注意的時候全力一推，把它推進了房間中央敞開的井口，接著它發出了一聲可怕的尖叫。
不論以何方式把它擊敗，都閱讀以下文字：
解決了那頭怪物之後，你得以稍為輕鬆地探索那頭怪物的隱修之處。這幢石砌建築殘破的牆壁上掛著許多掛毯，上面講述著這片土地的歷史，這段歷史寫的盡是鮮血與苦痛，你連一個字也不想記進心裡。目之所及，到處都是白雪覆蓋的巨大山峰。其中一座山峰上坐落著以黑線織就的一幢城堡。

cards.name: Beyond Dreams
cards.text: Objective - If each investigator is at the Onyx Gates, and no clues are on it, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 -如果如果每位調查員均位於縞瑪瑙大門，並且該地點上沒有線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. Read Scenario Interlude: Grand Design in the Campaign Guide. Then, advance to Act 4a - "Truth and Lies."
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員失去自己的全部線索。 閱讀劇本手冊中的幕間故事：一盤大棋。然後，推進到場景4a—"真實與謊言"。

cards.name: Truth and Lies
cards.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Look at the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Draw each of those cards with the hidden keyword and discard the rest. Objective - Find and expose Nyarlathotep's true form by adding copies of Nyarlathotep to the victory display. If 1 plus 1 [per_investigator] copies are in the victory display, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費1個線索：查看遭遇牌堆頂上的3張卡牌。抽取這3張卡牌中帶有隱私關鍵詞的所有卡牌，棄掉其餘卡牌。 目標 - 將奈亞拉托提普放入勝利牌區，以找出並揭露它的真形。如果勝利牌區有1[per_investigator]+1張奈亞拉托提普，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
Check Campaign Log. If the black cat knows the truth and the investigators possess the Silver Key:
As the shadows disperse, the black cat appears on your shoulder. "Now!" it cries. The silver key shimmers with radiant light as you draw it out. "This is the only way to expose its true shape!"
Each investigator loses each of their clues. Each copy of Nyarlathotep in the victory display combines to form a single enemy with: - Fight/evade values equal to the highest fight/evade value among combined copies of itself. - Health/damage/horror/victory values equal to the total combined health/damage/horror/victory values of all combined copies of itself. - All keywords from all combined copies of itself. Spawn this monstrosity in The Great Hall. It is Nyarlathotep's True Shape. Place clues on each Forsaken Tower location until it has clues equal to its clue value.
Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn:
查看冒險日誌。如果黑貓得知真相，並且調查員持有銀鑰匙︰
黑影消散時，黑貓出現在你的肩膀上。"就是現在！"它大喊道。你掏出銀鑰匙時它發出了燦爛的光芒。"只有這樣才能揭露它的真形！"
每位調查員失去自己所有的線索。勝利牌區的所有奈亞拉托提普組成了一個敵人，並且： - 其攻擊值/躲避值，等於勝利牌區中奈亞拉托提普最高的對應值。 - 其生命值/傷害值/恐懼值/勝利點數，等於勝利牌區中所有奈亞拉托提普的對應值總和。 - 其具有勝利牌區中所有奈亞拉托提普的關鍵詞。 將這可憎的異形生成在大禮堂。這就是奈亞拉托提普的真形。在每張被遺忘的高塔地點上放置線索，直到其線索數量等於其線索值。
否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: The Dream-Eaters
cards.text: Nyarlathotep's True Shape gets -1 health for each clue the investigators possess, as a group. Objective - If Nyarlathotep's True Shape is defeated, advance.
cards.text_cn: 調查員以團隊為單位每有1個線索，奈亞拉托提普的真形生命值-1。 目標 -如果奈亞拉托提普的真形被擊敗，推進場景。

cards.name: Plateau of Leng
cards.text: Forced - When an enemy attempts to spawn at an empty location, and there are no empty locations in play: Spawn that enemy here, instead.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人試圖生成在無人地點，且場上沒有無人地點時：改為將該敵人生成在此地。

cards.name: Cold Wastes
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] chaos token while investigating Cold Wastes: You must either take 1 damage or lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你調查冰封荒土時，在你抽出[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]混亂標記後：你必須受到1點傷害或失去1次行動。

cards.name: Monastery of Leng
cards.text: [fast] Investigators at Monastery of Leng spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that the investigators "maneuvered the priest closer."
cards.text_cn: [free]位於冷原隱修院的調查員以團隊為單位，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：記住調查員"靠近了祭司"。
cards.back_text: The door to the Monastery of Leng is sealed shut. You cannot enter the Monastery of Leng.
cards.back_text_cn: 隱修院的門被封起來了。你不能進入冷原隱修院。

cards.name: Onyx Gates
cards.text: Onyx Gates gets +1 [per_investigator] shroud. Forced - After Onyx Gates is revealed: Check Campaign Log. Remove 1 clue from Onyx Gates for each tally mark recorded next to "Evidence of Kadath."
cards.text_cn: 縞瑪瑙大門隱藏值+1[per_investigator]。 強制 - 在縞瑪瑙大門揭示後：查看冒險日誌。"卡達斯的證據"旁邊每有1次記錄，移除縞瑪瑙大門上的1個線索。

cards.name: The Great Hall
cards.text: [action]: Choose another investigator at your location. Add a hidden card in your hand to the chosen investigator's hand.
cards.text_cn: [action]：選擇你所在地點的另一位調查員。將你手牌中的一張隱私卡加入所選調查員的手牌。
cards.back_text: The way to The Onyx Castle is hidden. You cannot enter The Onyx Castle.
cards.back_text_cn: 前往縞瑪瑙城堡的道路隱藏了起來。你不能進入縞瑪瑙城堡。

cards.name: Forsaken Tower
cards.text: You cannot use this location's [action] ability unless another card explicitly allows you to do so. [action]: Investigate. Choose and reveal a copy of Nyarlathotep from your hand. For this investigation, this location's shroud is equal to Nyarlathotep's printed health. If you succeed, add that copy of Nyarlathotep to the victory display. If you fail, Nyarlathotep attacks you and is shuffled into the encounter deck.

cards.text:
Alert. Massive. Retaliate.
This enemy cannot make attacks of opportunity.
[fast] If this enemy is exhausted, spend 1 [per_investigator] clues: Remember that you "stunned the priest." Until the end of the scenario, this enemy gets -3 fight.

警戒。龐大。反擊。
本敵人不能進行趁亂攻擊。
[free]如果本敵人被消耗，花費1[per_investigator]個線索：記住你"打暈了祭司"。本場冒險結束前，本敵人攻擊值-3。

cards.text: Spawn - Cold Wastes or The Great Hall. Prey - Lowest [agility]. Hunter.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 冰封荒土或大禮堂。 獵物 - [agility]最低的目標。 獵手。

cards.text: Prey - Most cards in hand. Hunter. Forced - When Liar with No Face attacks you, if Whispering Chaos is in your hand: Reveal it. Liar with No Face deals +2 damage for this attack.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 手牌最多的目標。 獵手。 強制 - 在無面欺詐者攻擊你時，如果混沌低語在你手牌中：將其揭示。無面欺詐者在本次攻擊中造成+2傷害。

cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add this card to your hand. While this card is in your hand, you may activate the ability on the Northern Tower if you reveal this card from your hand. If the ability on the Northern Tower resolves successfully, discard this card. If it fails, shuffle this card back into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Journey Across the Bridge
cards.text: Each location is connected to each location above and below it. Objective - If each investigator is at the bottommost location, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個地點都與自己上方和下方的地點相互連接。 目標 -如果如果每位調查員均位於最下方的地點，調查員可以以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Spider Queen in the Campaign Guide. Then, advance to Act 2a - "The Weaver of the Cosmos."
cards.back_text_cn: 閱讀劇本手冊中的幕間故事：蛛后。然後，然後，推進到場景2a—"編織宇宙"。

cards.name: The Weaver of the Cosmos
cards.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Deal 3 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location. Forced - When the mythos phase begins: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If its modifier is negative, spin Atlach-Nacha clockwise X times. X is the token's negative modifier. Objective - If 4 Legs of Atlach-Nacha are in the victory display, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費1個線索：對你所在地點的1個[[古神]]敵人造成3點傷害。 強制 - 在神話階段開始時：從混亂袋隨機抽出1個標記。如果該標記修正值為負值，將阿特拉克·納克亞順時針旋轉X次，其中X為該負值修正值。 目標 - 如果勝利牌區有4張阿特拉克·納克亞之腿，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Flip Atlach-Nacha's center card over, to its enemy side. Place it at the location with the most doom in it.
cards.back_text_cn: 將阿特拉克·納克亞的中央卡牌翻面，翻至敵人面。將其放在毀滅標記最多的地點上。

cards.name: The Scheme's Demise
cards.text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Deal 3 damage to an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location. Forced - When the mythos phase begins: Reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If its modifier is negative, move Atlach-Nacha clockwise X times. X is the token's negative modifier. Objective - If Atlach-Nacha is defeated, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費1個線索：對你所在地點的1個[[古神]]敵人造成3點傷害。 強制 - 在神話階段開始時：從混亂袋隨機抽出1個標記。如果該標記修正值為負值，將阿特拉克·納克亞朝順時針方向移動X次，其中X為該負值修正值。 目標 -如果阿特拉克·納克亞被擊敗，推進場景。

cards.name: The Great Web
cards.text: Forced - After this location is revealed: Place 1 doom on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本地點翻開之後：在其上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: The Great Web
cards.text: Forced - After you enter this location: Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either choose and discard 1 card from your hand for each point you failed by, or place 1 doom on this location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入本地點後：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定失敗，你必須放置1個毀滅標記到本地點，或者每低於難度1點即選擇並丟棄1張手牌。

cards.name: The Great Web
cards.text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends, if there is at least 1 investigator at this location: Place 1 doom on this location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在調查階段結束時，如果本地點有調查員：在本地點上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: The Great Web
cards.text: Forced - After you enter this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either lose 1 action for each point you failed by, or place 1 doom on this location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你進入本地點後：檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定失敗，你必須放置1個毀滅標記到本地點，或者每低於難度1點即失去1個行動。

cards.name: The Great Web
cards.text: [action] If it is not act 1, and there are 1 [per_investigator] or fewer clues on this location: Move. Move to the location directly across from this location.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果當前場景非場景1，並且本地點上有不超過1[per_investigator]個線索：移動。直接移動到本地點正對面的地點。

cards.name: The Great Web
cards.text: As an additional cost to investigate this location, you must either spend 1 action or place 1 doom on this location.
cards.text_cn: 作為調查本地點的額外費用，你必須花費1個行動或在本地點上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Atlach-Nacha
cards.text: Massive. Forced - When Atlach-Nacha leaves a location: If there are no investigators at that location, place 1 doom there. Otherwise, it attacks each investigator at that location. Forced - After you evade Atlach-Nacha: Instead of exhausting it, choose an investigator at your location. It cannot attack the chosen investigator this round.
cards.text_cn: 龐大。 強制 - 在阿特拉克·納克亞離開一個地點時：如果該地點上沒有調查員，在該地點上放置1個毀滅標記。否則，其攻擊該地點的每位調查員。 強制 - 在你躲避阿特拉克·納克亞後：其不消耗，改為選擇你所在地點的1位調查員。它本輪不能攻擊所選調查員。

cards.name: Legs of Atlach-Nacha
cards.text: Massive. This enemy cannot make attacks of opportunity. X is the shroud value of this enemy's location. Forced - When you would evade this enemy: Instead of exhausting it, choose an investigator at your location. This enemy cannot attack the chosen investigator this round.
cards.text_cn: 龐大。 本敵人不能進行趁亂攻擊。 X為本敵人所在地點的隱藏值。 強制 - 在你將要躲避本敵人時：其不消耗，改為選擇你所在地點的1位調查員。本敵人本輪不能攻擊所選調查員。

cards.name: Web-Spinner
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location. Aloof. Forced - At the end of the round, if Web-Spinner is ready: Place 1 doom on Web-Spinner's location.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 任意一個無人地點。 冷漠。 強制 - 當一輪結束時，如果織網者為準備狀態：在織網者所在地點放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: The Spinner in Darkness
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Ancient One]] enemy. Attached enemy gets +1 damage and +1 horror. [action]: Test any skill (5). If you succeed, discard The Spinner in Darkness.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到最近的[[古神]]敵人。 疊加到的敵人+1傷害+1恐懼。 [action]：檢定任意一項技能(5)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄黑暗中的織網者。

cards.name: Caught in a Web
cards.text: Revelation - Put Caught in a Web into play in your threat area. You get -1 [agility] and cannot take more than one move action each round. [action]: Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, discard Caught in a Web.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將陷入網中放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 你-1[agility]，並且每輪不能進行超過1個移動行動。 [action]：檢定[combat](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄陷入網中。

cards.name: Endless Weaving
cards.text: Revelation - Choose a [[Spider]] enemy in play. If it is engaged with an investigator, it makes an immediate attack, along with each of its swarm/host cards. Otherwise, place 1 doom on its location. If there are no [[Spider]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Spider]] enemy and draw it. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 選擇場上的1個[[蜘蛛]]敵人。如果其與調查員交戰，其立即進行攻擊，其所有蜂擁/頭領卡牌也一同攻擊。否則，在該敵人所在地點放置1個毀滅標記。如果場上沒有[[蜘蛛]]敵人，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取1張[[蜘蛛]]敵人。混洗遭遇牌堆。
